reviews.title: This device appears to produce excessive EMFs (electromagnetic fields)
reviews.text:
My entire family has had 1-2 Dohm machines in their bedroom for years now.  And recently, I started researching EMF's (electromagnetic fields) and a concept known as 'dirty electricity'.  My interest was peaked because the new home we moved into has solar panels and 2 different Smart Meters.  Both are known for their EMF and dirty electricity production, so I was concerned our exposure may have increased.

I ordered a $40 EMF reader from Amazon, and began checking the EMF levels in and around our home.  Quite by accident, I discovered that the Dohm produces far more EMF's than anything else in or around our home.  To put things in perspective, the Smart Meters generated up to 250uTs, and our running microwave produced anywhere from 50 to 80uTs.  The Dohm completely maxed out my reader!  I believe it goes to 300uTs, so obviously the Dohm produces more than that.

And even more disturbing is that it STAYED maxed out.  On the Smart Meters, the value would spike in the 200's, but then drop down and jump all over the place.  But not the Dohm, it pegged the reader right away and stayed there.  Even on the low setting!  I realize there are differing opinions regarding the safe levels of EMF's, but this seems way too high.  Especially for something that you are likely sleeping next to, for many hours at a time.

I have retired all of our Dohm machines, and will not be using them again.

I just used mine in various hotel rooms on a cross-country road trip with my family. It got rave reviews from my kids, who slept better and longer in a shared room. That trip alone was worth the purchase.

We found placement of the device was much more effective than tuning the air gaps to adjust the sound. Sitting the device on the a carpeted floor absorbed more of the high-frequency sounds and resulted in better natural background noise. Elevated on a desk, the sound was a bit more harsh and less pleasant.

This is going in my toolbox for family travel for now on, and will be handy when hosting guests at my house.

reviews.title: Once hated, now prized.
reviews.text:
When I first heard one of these I HATED it. I was in an office out somewhere and it was already quiet in the room. All I could hear was this loud constant whoosh and it rivaled the noise in my head. I could not stand it.

But my husband started running a box fan in the bedroom at night and I was getting cold. Not to mention dust I'm allergic to would fly if it'd been a few days after vacuuming. I thought of this unit. I was already used to the fan noise at night. This thing had to improve the shiver/dust situation.

Oh, did it. It's become essential for my husband to get good sleep at night, and I've noticed when it's off that I go to sleep better and faster once I turn it on, especially now that I'm not freezing from all that blowing box fan air.

Months later I realized I was constantly agitated from high noise levels in a poorly sound-proofed home, but didn't know how to fix it. In the meantime, I'd bought a unit for my dad because trains were waking him up at night. However, it annoyed him like it had first annoyed me, so he didn't continue to use it. Then I thought of this unit and wondered if it might actually help mask the daytime noises, so Dad let me bring it home.

I regret not getting one sooner.

In a noisy environment, this thing gives me peace of mind. In my home office I can finally think when my husband is watching the yapper (TV) in the other room. And the kids and dogs amping up the noise, along with my constant companion, Tinnitus, fade away in this sweet, soothing whoosh.

My tinnitus makes me sensitive to high pitched noises, so I'm grateful I can adjust the pitch to what feels best to my ears. Perhaps that's why the first unit I heard drove me nuts--wrong pitch for me. I close most of the top and side holes for a lower pitch. Open them for a higher, louder pitch, and I start climbing the walls, but others might like it much better than what feels good to my being.

This was by far a valuable purchase for us and I recommend it to anyone needing some mental solitude in a loud environment.

reviews.text: Our third child developed severe GERD as an infant and by pure coincidence we realized that the sound made by a vacuum seemed to distract him and recede his crying fits while feeding.  After blowing through the motor of a brand new shop-vac, from nearly 1 year of frequent use, our little one became "conditioned" to needing this sound to go to sleep.  So, we decided to look for other options.  We purchased the Dohm-SS Sound Conditioner after reading the reviews on Amazon.  This machine did the trick to help our little one sleep soundly.  We have even taken it on vacation with us and it enabled our tot to sleep soundly in a pack n play in strange place, something that our older kids certainly never did.  Our little one is now 4 and while he doesn't "need" this little machine anymore, as he can sleep soundly in any environment, its still going strong and has become a part of his night time routine.

We decided to go with a different product mostly because of the power consumption, we had no idea this was rated to use 40w.  While that isnt much, I feel it is like using an old incandescent  bulb when most others are as efficient as LED bulbs. reviews.text: I am not a great sleeper, one of those who tends to wake up easily when noise enters the room - a cat scratching on the door, one of the kids running up the steps, birds chirping at 5 AM in the summer when the windows are open.  If I have been asleep for more than 4-6 hours, I will end up not being able to get back to sleep.  I LOVE to run a box fan as I noticed that I sleep better with the noise and the gentle breeze.  But while researching white noise as a possible sleep aid I came to realize that is is likely not the breeze that I was enjoying, but the white noise created by the fan.  So in the endless quest for good nights' sleep, I decided to order this Dohm machine and see how it went.  I've been using it for several weeks now and, although it is very hard to quantify the benefit, I am convinced the machine is helping me sleep better.  It creates a nice noise zone which normal small household sounds cannot penetrate.  If you enjoy sleeping with a fan on, or other consistent background noise, I encourage you to give one of these a try.  I gave it 5 starts for the simple reason that ANYTHING that helps me sleep better, longer or deeper gets a top rating.  And I believe this is working well for me.

reviews.title: Great Product and Company
reviews.text: This is an excellent product from an outstanding US company (and it's made in America).  My extended family has bought a number of these over the past 20 years (they last forever) and we use them every night to provide white noise while we sleep.  I purchased this particular unit because my family and I were planning to live in Europe for two years and I wanted to leave the one we currently had at home so it would be here when we came back for short stays.  This new one, though, went with us.  On our first night in Italy, I plugged the unit in and blew the motor.  I hadn't checked to see if the unit was dual voltage, which it is not.  Most electronics are now, so it hadn't dawned on me to look.  Anyway, I was disappointed because I had become so accustomed to using this.  When I returned to the US for a short visit, I contacted the company and explained what happened and admitted that it was my fault.  Without hesitating, the customer service representative told me to send the unit to them and they would fix it.  They did so at no charge to me--and they even paid return postage.  I liked the product before, but I'm now an even more loyal customer.

reviews.title: I love this thing
reviews.text:
I love this thing.

I have terrible insomnia. Sometimes I can't sleep without complete silence. I live in the city and there's so much outside noise. And my housemates have a completely different sleeping schedule than me. I tolerated it for a few years before I was so sleepy all the time that I couldn't take it anymore. That's when I found this. I first saw it in a counseling center at my school. I didn't know what it was because I thought most white noise machines were tracks being played. But this is better. I slept with a fan on my nightstand in the summer and I found out that this drowns out the noise. So I use this in the other months when it's too cold to use a fan. It has helped me sleep soundly. It blocks out enough noise that if someone were to call me from outside, I wouldn't hear a thing. I can't hear cars passing by or people talking on the street. I can't hear things through the walls. I have this thing on the floor right near my head. I think the placement matters.

The only bad thing about this thing is that the motor is making noises now. It used to smell the first few times I used it too. It was this plastic smell as the machine heated from overnight use. It disappeared after a week and the machine doesn't get nearly as hot anymore. I'm a bit disappointed that the motor is kind of dying but I think it has to do with dust. For my next one, I'm going to be careful with the dusty on the floor. I tried to open my current one up but I haven't been able to unsnapped certain parts to get the hood to pop off. I've had mine for almost two years now. I see that some people have had theirs for much longer. I guess the quality has diminished or there was a bad batch. But it's so essential to my sound sleep that I just don't care about paying $40ish every two years.

If you're debating whether or not to buy it, go for it. But be aware that it literally sounds like a fan without the wind. If you can't stand that type of white noise, then don't get it. I find it soothing.

reviews.title: Overpriced, but the best white noise I've found
reviews.text:
We currently own 3 of these single speed Dohm machines.  We bought the first one 5 years ago for the nursery.  It was the perfect white noise sound, and it was super small so easy to pack for trips.  So we bought a second one about a year late, just before my husband's business trip.  Unfortunately about 6 months ago the older one started rattling a little bit.  Not much, but it was enough to annoy me, so I knew it could interfere with the kids sleep.  I really didn't want to pay $45 for this tiny little machine.  However, I sucked it up and bought a third one.  The only negative is the price.

The positives include:

- natural white noise sound (nothing like those awful Homemedic digital noise machines)
- can adjust the white noise by twisting it
- small and portable (easy to pack for trips, and takes up very little room on a dresser)
- has a mechanical switch so it's not digital.  Therefore it won't crap out as soon as a digital Homemedic machine, AND if the power flickers off (like it did for us twice last night in the wee hours), as soon as power is restored this machine starts working again.  So our 5 year olds didn't even notice it or wake up, since the outage was only for a few minutes at a time.  We, however, still use a digital air purifier in our bedroom for white noise, so at 4am, well after the brief outage, I woke up thinking "Why is it so quiet??"

reviews.title: Excellent, Sanity-Saving Product
reviews.text: I just received my second Marpac Dohm Sound Screen. My first is 20 years-old, and it's still working perfectly! Some reviewers have said that the Dohm is too loud, others have said it is too soft. Others have said it smells. To address these complaints: the Dohm comes with directions on how to adjust the frequency and volume of the whooshing air sound. The cap twists, as does the cuff around the Dohm, going from loud and bright, to soft and dull, and everything in between. As for the smell, it is simply a new product smell which goes away in a couple of days. New cars, new dolls at Christmas time, and new DVD cases have stronger odors that last longer. I turned my new Dohm on right out of the box, and let it run for two hours. It has already lost most of the "new plastic" smell. I use mine primarily to drown out the barking of my neighbor's 3 dogs that are tethered in their yard 24/7, and it works. The old one is in my bedroom, allowing a good night sleep, and the new one is in my home office. Thank you, Marpac!

reviews.text:

I believe I originally purchased this so I could read in the bathroom without the television interrupting me. (I have health problems, so sometimes "reading sessions" are necessary.) It eventually migrated to my bedroom when I realized I wanted help with dogs barking at night. And birds chirping in the morning. And crickets during the summer. I really intend to try to sleep some night without it on, but I always find an excuse not to! (I have in the past, though.)

My only real complaint is that it can't handle percussive noises--hammering, neighbors playing basketball, gunfire and other joys of living in the country. But for everything else, it's very, VERY good, and I have a hard time living without it.

reviews.title: Fire Hazard?
reviews.text:
After about three and a half years of almost nightly use, this thing finally bit the dust in a big way.  I always thought this machine ran a little warm, but seeing as how it is purely a mechanical device it didn't worry me much.  As a side point, I now find it a little odd that nowhere can I find a power consumption rating for this, not even on the company website.  What is this thing costing to run each night??

Anyway, a couple nights ago as my wife and I were going to sleep, the Dohm just stopped working, and shortly thereafter a cloud of stinky smoke started coming from it.  Thankfully we were awake, unplugged it and removed it from the premises.  What would have happened if we were sound asleep when this happened?  I don't know, but I'm glad to not have found out.

I took it apart to see what happened, and I think it was the power supply that went bad.  There was a black material surrounding it that was all melted so that must have been where the smoke was coming from.

Doesn't look like the one year warranty is going to cover this one!  Now I'm hesitant about buying another one after this experience.  While we very much enjoyed the soothing sound of the Dohm, I'm not sure I want to risk burning the house down with us inside of it while we are sound asleep thanks to said machine.  It's a dilemma for sure.  I think I'm going to look into other options.

Update: Just ordered the [[ASIN:B00E6D6LQY LectroFan - Fan Sound and White Noise Machine]] This is a lot of money to spend on a noise maker but I see a lot of positive reviews on it and compares favorably to the Dohm.  And hopefully the fact that it does not having moving parts, presumably will require less power, and not threaten our lives, will be a plus.

It's a great deal for the price though, and it's not so bad that I am going to buy a different machine. I like that it runs on an on/off switch rather than a timer, as some other brands do - this way, when I turn this machine on, it is on until I turn it off - no spontaneous shut-offs that lead to her waking up.

UPDATE: 9/20/2015 - almost 2 years later, and I feel like I should update this review. We have been using this sound machine every night (and nap time) since we bought it. I originally thought it wasn't quite loud enough for our daughter's nursery, but over time I have come to realize that it is just the right volume and level to help her sleep without me having to be concerned about her hearing. There are other 'sleep noise' products that are probably just too LOUD to be using every night. With this Dohm sound machine, I don't worry about whether her hearing is being negatively impacted by the noise. It IS possible to hear loud noises outside of the room when using this machine, but the machine provides a great sound to dull most noises to a background level. It also is not so loud that it is distracting or intrusive in a way that would keep you from falling asleep.
In the 2 years we have been using this, my daughter has slept great. We even pack it with us when we travel - I am willing to give up valuable suitcase carry-on room for this machine when we fly, so that should let you know how great I think it is. My daughter even asks me to turn the machine on before she goes to bed if I forget.
I am currently ordering a 2nd of this same item since we are expecting a new baby again, and I want to use this machine in the newborn's nursery as well since it's been so helpful for promoting good sleep for our first child.
I've updated my product review to 5 stars.

reviews.title: Good Quality Sound Machine, Just Not For Me...
reviews.text:
Very good quality sound machine with a few drawbacks. My wife and I have been using sound  machines, air purifiers, and/or fans since we were both children. I have never been able to sleep well without some sort of white noise in the background. We had been using a homedics machine (sorry can't recall the model) for about 10 years - and had been reasonable satisfied. However, I had wanted to buy this machine for years and found it on sale for ~ $35 after Christmas last year (on Prime!) - I couldn't resist.

After reading all the great reviews I had very high expectations - my fault. I say this because I was disappointed with the sound machine. I anticipated the sound manipulations will really help me select an optimal background sound - it did not. First, there is no true volume control - you can adjust the volume by limiting the size of the wholes, but only within a pretty tight range; there is no way to limit the volume to a low level. Second, the sound was all in the same style, we did not find changing the sound to make any real difference on whether the sound would be pleasing. It was hit-or-miss, just like any other $20 sound machine.

We also take our sound machine when we travel; however, we had always balked at the size of the machine. The Dohm sound machine is smaller in size than the previous Homedics, however, it is much heavier - there is no way we could travel with it.

Despite the negatives (some subjective), I did not want to take away more than one star from Dohm sound machine. The assembly/build are great and the sound is consistent and I'm sure very good for users that like the tone. I'm just not one of them.

reviews.text: I have used a white noise machine for the past 15 years to help me sleep.  My old one broke last year and I did a lot of research to see what machine I should buy. I have been sleeping so well!  So very happy with this machine.

reviews.title: Great for baby's room (and your room!)
reviews.text:
We bought this for our daughter when she was a newborn.  She has always slept with it and I think part of the reason she is such a good sleeper is because of this!  For the first little bit she was in our room and I have really missed using this at night to sleep!  I almost bought myself one!

Why this is perfect for baby:
-The sound is not recorded so it doesnt repeat the same pattern over and over.

-I love that it just has an on/off switch, I didnt want a sound machine that was going to turn off after my daughter fell asleep

-It helps cover noises in the rest of the house.  My daughter will sleep through the doorbell ringing and the fire alarm going off but as soon as I go into her room and turn off the sound machine she start to stir

-It's pretty portable, we always take it on vacations/ trips to grandmas

-You can change the sound by rotating the top part or the sides, if we know things are going to be a little louder we can adjust the sound conditioner accordingly

Other thoughts:
-I like to sleep with a fan so I found the noise this makes to be very soothing.  If you like to sleep with a fan then you will love this!

-Dont expect this to cover up every noise, thats not really the point, it will help drown out other noises so if you are asleep or working you wont be distracted by them.  I know some people complain about this, but to completely block out all other noises that sound conditioner would have to be really loud and I think that would be worse than the offending noises.  It's sort of like wearing earplugs, you can still sort of hear things but they dont bother you anymore.

-Be to follow the instructions not place the sound conditioner right next to your head (like your nightstand) and it will work better.  This seems counterintuitive, but it works.

Bottom line:  This is worth every penny!  For us, this was a splurge.  We didnt have a lot to spend on baby stuff but this made the cut and was WELL worth it, still in use today (1.5 years later). We are about to have another baby so we just bought another to have in our room when she gets home from the hospital and I am excited to keep it when she shares a room with her sister!  Don't be surprised if you buy this for your kid and end of stealing it from them!

reviews.title: Perfect for me
reviews.text:
Quite simply, this product works very well for an apartment dweller, person who enjoys quiet or a grad student. If you enjoy or need white noise or the sound of a fan to focus, but you lack a proper sound system and a fan would be too chilly in the winter--try this product.

I recently moved into a very old apartment building where the walls and windows are extremely thin. I listened to my neighbors shout and others manage to sound like a full-on zombie chorus until I could not take it anymore. I was rescued from the chaos of the cafeteria, shopping mall and frat party to relax in TRANQUILITY at last, for $40!
-------------------------------------------------------
My personal experiences in detail:

What the Dohm-SS does not drown out:
My neighbor's noisy truck or its beeping sound, neighbor tramping up the stairs, slamming doors, sirens (obviously and fortunately!)

What the Dohm-SS DOES drown out:
 outdoor voices, indoor voices, outdoor college parties 1200 yards away, my downstairs neighbor's techno music, most construction sounds

Keep in mind that I can hear everything that my neighbors do, especially if it involves the stairs, but at least now their ruckus is silent or muffled.

If I were to purchase 3 of of these they would totally block out all noise, if that were my objective. As it is, one Dohm-SS is sufficient to provide solace for a moderate sized bedroom. I position the Dohm as far away from me as possible at night, either near the door or the window. I am a fan of peace and quiet and now I've a much better option that wearing ear plugs--hooray!

-------------------------------------------------------------
Good for: dorms, apartment dwellers, people sensitive to noise, students, test taking, privacy, people with attention difficulties

It's easy to set up. Plug it in and adjust the holes on the top so that the sound is pleasing to your ear.

In short, I do not regret spending my hard earned cash on this sound conditioner. Enjoy the wave of tranquility it brings and kiss goodbye the majority of the discordant shrieks, moans and raucous noise of your neighbors!

reviews.text: Simply the best solution for light sleepers. I have an older, original Sleepmate that was purchased for me as a gift in 1985. I'm still using it! I tried two different electronic sound machines and was very disappointed with each one. My other solution that works well (but is wasteful of energy unless one is hot) is a standard portable electric fan. The Marpac machine is solid, simple, consistent and puts out enough noise to blend other unwanted sounds into the background. It's a truly effective white noise source that can help you get a good night's sleep. reviews.title: This is our second.
reviews.text:
We originally owned the 2 speed motor version of this same sound machine.  We since worn it out and ordered this model.

What we like:
* It is a "loud" sound machine.
* The top and side can slide to change the pitch and volume.
* We use this for our children to sleep better while we watch TV at night, and they enjoy turning it on themselves.

12 Months of real experience:
* If you run it all night, every night.  After about a year the motor lost it's lubrication and struggle to turn on.  I removed the screws from the bottom, added some light oil and it improved instantly.  This is likely just the result of how we use it.
* We dropped it once, and it didn't fair well.  This is why we now own a new one.  The edges are not kid friendly if they pick it up and then drop it from about 2 feet.

Recommendation:
We obviously liked it well enough to purchase it twice.  We wish the top better held up to dropping.  We love the results it has on our children's ability to sleep despite loud noises outside their room.

reviews.title: Thank Goodness for this Machine!
reviews.text:
Finally I can fall to sleep. I read 100+ reviews about this machine (and there were hundreds more to read) to make sure this was the last Sound Machine I would ever need. It really works. I, too, didn't see the need for 2-speed machine and cost was an issue. When I first turned it on I thought, "Oh dear, this noise will never put me to sleep!". That was my first and last thought until I awoke several hours later.
I have really bad Tinnitus, which gets worse as the day turns into night. By the time I'm ready to go to sleep, the ringing in my ear sounds like a bunch of kids screaming & yelling. When I awoke, I noticed that the 'ringing' had subsided to a very low level.
My husband balked at the 'noise' for about 10 seconds..., then all I heard was his slow, rhythmic breathing.
I decided to purchase 2 machines so that we could use one for our dog as she shakes and trembles from all the illegal fireworks that go off in our town during the whole summer tourist season. Our dog has her own little room set up with a cozy bed, her "Thunder Shirt" and the Sound Machine. She can't hear the fireworks with this machine so she's no longer in extreme distress! I prefer using the sound machine over giving her tranquilizers every time.

I assumed this was from the manufacturing process and it would dissipate quickly, but after running all night the odor persists. So, if the device is off-gassing from the plastic housing, running it is actually making it worse. Again, time will tell. I'll update in a few days...

reviews.title: Great for nurseries, surprisingly effective, but WAY overpriced...
reviews.text: I'm glad I held off on reviewing this item until we'd had it for a while because when I first received it I almost sent it back. I bought this for my son who has always needed background noise to sleep well. We have just used a fan in the past but his room is the coldest room in the house so I was looking for an alternative to the fan that wouldn't make his room even colder. When you turn it on, it sounds way too quiet to believe it would mask any background noise. And at first, it really doesn't seem to block out any noise. But once it's been on for a while, you honestly don't notice any other noise but the sound of the machine, which itself is quite soothing. It's not that it masks or blocks the noise, it just seems to trick your brain somehow into not noticing the noise, if that makes sense. And the nice thing is we can take it wherever we go unlike the fan. We took it to our summer home to use up in the loft where the kids sleep and it really helped them fall asleep even with all of the grownups downstairs talking. I would love to buy one of these for every room in our house but that's the downside--the price is WAY to expensive to justify purchasing more than one. Especially when fans are just as effective and you can buy those for 8 bucks at Home Depot. Which is really too bad since I could see every Mom in America having one of these in their nurseries if it were more affordable so I'm not sure why the price point has to be so high. I'm still giving it 5 stars though because it's definitely an effective product so if you have money to burn then go ahead and splurge!

reviews.title: A More Peaceful Sleep
reviews.text:
I work nights so when I'm trying to sleep during the day there are lots of daytime noises that keep me awake, or wake me up mid-sleep even in my relatively quiet neighborhood - trash trucks, dogs, lawnmowers, obnoxiously cheerful birds...that sort of stuff. This unit was recommend my several of my fellow vampire coworkers (all nurses). I was a bit hesitant because of the price - I had tried several digital white noise and nature sound machines, several apps on my phone, a window AC unit, and an oscillating fan. I can't get to sleep with the digital machines and the apps because they typically rely on a loop of noise that I always end up hearing where it's seamed together which then drives me crazy. The window AC actually works great, but it's not practical unless it's hot outside, and the fan was useless. So after a string of sleepless nights I finally bit the bullet and pick up the Dohm and am extremely glad I did.

The unit is very customizable to whatever volume and pitch of noise you need. By rotating the two different sets of slits you can change the pitch, tone, and volume of air the flows through the machine until you find what's exactly what's right for you. Because the noise is generated mechanically, there's no looping of sound files and low quality samples output through phone speakers. There is a dual-speed option out there for a little more money, but from my own research and talking to the nurses that had recommended the unit there's very little need for the lower speed that is available with the more expensive unit. None of the other users or reviewers found any need to make the unit any quieter than what could be customized on this single speed unit. In short, the Dohm has drastically improved my quality of sleep and made me a happier person.

It took me about a week to get used to it... it was too loud and mechanical sounding... like a jet plane engine at first. But when I got used to it and played around with twisting the collar around... well, now I always have to have it on. And now I notice I sleep a lot better and I have an easier time falling asleep almost instantly as soon as I turn it on. It definitely won't completely drown out all noise but it helps to drown out any noises my family makes downstairs, my dogs barking, cats scratching at my door and neighbors snowblowing (its winter and I live in New England!) I am completely dependent on this to fall asleep now. Its so tiny, I imagine it would be super easy to take almost anywhere should I ever need to. The only drawback is that its kinda ugly. But that's honestly the only negative thing I can say about it.

reviews.text:
I got very lucky that this sound machine went on sale as a lightning deal for $36 just one day after the Brookstone sound machine I'd had for over a decade finally went kaput.

In looking through the Amazon reviews of other machines, it seemed like the highest quality ones were very expensive (for me), while the less expensive ones had reviews that complained of things that bothered me with previous machines, such as clicking noises or noticeable loops in the soundtrack.

This machine has neither problem, while still being relatively inexpensive. Note that there is only one noise setting - white noise, which is the only one I wanted; there are no crashing waves or babbling brooks.  I use it every night, and it's small and lightweight enough to pack in my carry-on bag for trips.

You control the sound by twisting the top of the machine to close or expose more openings.  There is not a lot of variation of the lowest and the highest volumes, which is the only drawback for me.  I like the volume of my noise machines to be quite loud, and I wish that this machine was louder.  It's not a problem for me at home, where I live alone in a quiet neighborhood.  If you are sleeping in an environment that has just moderately loud noises, I don't think this machine is loud enough to completely block those out.  (Right now, as I'm writing this review, I'm a houseguest at a relative's, and I'm sleeping in a guest room with the door closed.  With the machine on max volume, I can still hear my relative walking on the slightly creaky floors in the hallway, and I can hear doors opening and closing, even though it's the middle of the night, and everyone is trying to be quiet.)  So, I bring along earplugs on trips to supplement the machine, if needed.

reviews.text: I got this because I have very noisy roommates that I can hear through my air vent and I live right next to the alley so there are always people talking outside my window. It definitely helps with the roommate noise. However, I still have to sleep with earplugs in to drown out the noise of the white machine noise! The white noise is fine but it also makes an annoying mechanical sound in the background that might be some sort of fan. I find the noise to be really irritating, but I have very sensitive hearing. I would say that for the price, it was not worth the purchase.

reviews.title: Lifesaver for shift work
reviews.text:
This is the best-quality white noise generator I've ever tried. There's just no comparison between it and the cheaper devices sold by Homedic and the like, which play looped recordings. The truly random, constantly generated whooooooosh this machine makes is better than any number of "rainforest" or "beach" recordings which wake up up when the loop restarts. You can adjust the volume and pitch by twisting the top and sides of the unit.

If you like the noise of a fan while you sleep, but don't want to waste the electricity or change the temperature in your room, this is the perfect solution. It really does block sound, too- I work night shift and till recently shared an apartment with a very large and noisy dog, a cat, and a day shift roommate- and I slept like a baby through everything short of vacuuming right outside my door. Highly, highly recommended.

reviews.title: Works just as expected
reviews.text: We needed a sound barrier to help with night noise such as putting away dishes and loud fumble induced yelling on Monday nights. This works great, it provides a nice constant background sound without being distracting.  I recommend this for anyone who wants to receive quality sleep while other are awake :)

reviews.title: Sleep better...
reviews.text: I have bought three of these machines over the years, each time they were under a slightly different name or logo... but ALWAYS they help to block out noise and help to promote deep sleep.  I am a sleep-challenged person so I will take all the help I can get!  I TOTALLY recommend giving this a shot if you need something to block out noisy neighbors, roommates, partners snoring or just general background noise.

reviews.title: Ahhhh
reviews.text: Even on it's lowest setting, it masks the noise.  Restful enough to put you to sleep.  Better than any fan.

reviews.title: Best thing that ever happened to my sleep
reviews.text:
I cannot overstate how wonderful this thing is. I'm a very light sleeper and used to wake up several times a night. I can now sleep through everything. Sirens, roommates watching tv loudly right outside my bedroom, doors slamming--it seriously doesn't bother me anymore, which is amazing. I always make sure to bring it with me to hotels too so noise is never an issue.

I tried just using a fan for white noise for way too long but I would always wake up with an extremely dry throat, plus it never seemed to make enough noise to block everything out. I wish I would have bought this a long time ago.

reviews.title: If you have a snorer, get this
reviews.text: I am the snorer in our home, and without this my husband would get very little sleep. If it is allergy season and my snoring is particularly bad, even this cannot drown me out, but for the majority of the time it works well.

reviews.title: finally, some rest!
reviews.text: I've worked with white noise machines in the work setting before to drown out personal information from leaking through thin walls. I now live in a creaky house that always awakes me when my roommate gets up, so I got this machine after I read it's reviews. It seems loud when you turn it on, and I wasn't sure I'd be able to fall asleep to it as I love sleeping in silence. I was able to fall asleep and stay asleep! If you're skeptical on getting accustomed to it, know you can adjust how much noise is emitted by turning the vents. Another review mentioned the amount of (x) that's emitted that contributes to potential cancer development, so I just keep it across the room. If I do wake up, the noise pacifies me right back to sleep. Love it!

reviews.title: A good nights sleep!
reviews.text: I'm amazed at how this works...even more so now that I've been getting at least 8 hours sleep at night. Impressive for such a small machine!!!

reviews.title: Sweet Relief!
reviews.text: I can no longer hear my partying neighbors at night. What a relief! I used a fan all summer, but this is a much better option.

reviews.title: Just a distraction
reviews.text: After reading all the rave reviews, I thought this would be the solution to living in the apartment below two young children who are constantly running on their hardwood floors above me.  This machine does NOT block the sound.  It masks it a bit by giving the mind something else to focus on, but I can definitely still hear the noise.  I am very disappointed in this product.  It doesn't block outside noise either--I could still hear the leaf blowers loud and clear.

reviews.title: Love it!!!!
reviews.text: My sister has been bugging for over a year to get one of these.  Even my 87 yr old mother sleeps with one! I have trouble sleeping due to a variety of reasons, ie, noise, snoring, menapause, etc. However, from the first night I have slept so much better. I feel like i'm in the deepest sleep.  If I wake up to roll over, I think to myself, "wow, I feel like I've been in a coma!" Highly recommend!

reviews.title: Such a disappointment!
reviews.text: I read the reviews and was hoping that this Dohm Sound Conditioner would be loud enough to drown out the noise of barking dogs but my air purifier that I already have does a much better job.  I would send it back but am keeping it to use when I travel.  If you are buying this with the intention of drowning out background noise I would say don't bother.

reviews.title: Great product
reviews.text: Simple, and our son has been using it since he was three weeks old...  Works like a charm, and doesn't turn off like other noisemakers.

reviews.title: Dohm-SS Single Speed Sound Conditioner by Marpac
reviews.text: I go to bed earlier than my husband so when he has the TV blaring I have to turn mine on and I must say, it definitely works. We have a high ceiling in the living room and so everything is much louder. This works perfect and does a much better than my air cleaner. Worth buying.

reviews.title: It does what I wanted it to!
reviews.text: Between dogs lick/scratching and delivery trucks driving by in the middle of the night.....noises tend to wake us.  We've been sleeping with a fan on just to have some background noise and that works....except it's getting too cold to keep sleeping with this fan!  I bought the Dohm-SS Single Speed Sound Conditioner hoping that it can replace the fan.  Ironically it sounds a lot like the fan, except I'm not not being woken up cold with sore throat/stiff neck.  It's great too when taking mid-day nap and you want to drown out the noise from the rest of the household.  It does not make a "pretty" sound, however it does exactly what I expected it to and I don't think I could sleep without it.

reviews.title: Very good and long lasting
reviews.text: I purchased this in Dec of 2008. It is now July 2013 and we are still using it. I have used it every night plus for weekend naps. I love this product. With the white noise coming from this, I do not hear what is going on in the rest of the house or outside. When this does finally quit, I will most definitely buy another one to replace it.

reviews.title: Does we we wanted!
reviews.text: I wasn't sure this Dohm sound conditioner would do what we wanted and needed, but it works perfectly!  The white noise is a pleasantly pitched hum that can be adjusted.  I was afraid it might be annoyingly high pitched....no worries!  I am more than satisfied, we no longer hear the neighbors kennel dogs barking, nor the traffic.  We are sleeply soundly and recommend this product.

reviews.title: Best purchase ever!
reviews.text: Being a light sleeper, this machine has increased my sleep significantly. We take it when traveling too to help drown out outside noises or Hotel hallway disturbances. Best purchase ever.

reviews.title: I can sleep again !
reviews.text: After using one of these to drown out husband's snoring, I can't sleep without "white" noise. The one I had for 20 years was a 2 speed and when it quit working I went searching for a replacement. There is not a machine out there that provides the consistent "white" ,static free noise this machine does. I purchased the one speed after reading the single speed provides the same noise as the high setting on the 2 speed model. It does, and costs less ! You can adjust the noise by turning the top and or side which closes holes, and softens the sound if it's too loud. Amazon was the best place to buy ,quick shipping as always. I expect to get 20 years service out of this Marpac machine as well. Very happy with my choice of the one speed Marpac!

reviews.title: great to drown out noise from neighborhood dogs
reviews.text: This does an excellent job of drowning out the noise from barking dogs in the neighborhood. I imagine it would be also useful for when you sleep in a hotel and there's people walking around in the hallways and opening/closing doors when you sleep, so I'll likely bring it with me when I travel next.

reviews.title: Great for babies
reviews.text: We got this when we began sleep training our 6 month old. It does a great job blocking out noises so that we can all sleep better!

reviews.title: Great product!!
reviews.text: The Sleep-Mate I'd used almost every night (even taking it with me when I traveled) for the past 26+ years recently bit the dust and I couldn't get a new one ordered fast enough!  My old one was the 2-speed, but after reading the reviews I decided to go with the less expensive single speed and I could not be happier.  I think the newer ones must be a little quieter than my old one because I used my old one on low and it sounded about the same as this ones does (which, according to other reviewers, is the same as "high" on the new dual speed ones).  I think the fan-like sound is very soothing and does a great job masking other noises.  I'm not a fan of those sound machines that make waterfall, cricket, ocean, etc. sounds.  I find those extremely annoying and they don't drown out other noises - but THIS machine I love!  I'm curious to see how long this one will last, because if it holds up even a fraction as long as my other one did it will be well worth the price.

reviews.title: helps with noisy neighbors
reviews.text:
Living in a downstairs apartment + having sensitive ears = torture. After months of ear plugs and my upstairs neighbors loud stomping still distracting me from studying, I finally caved in and splurged on this sound conditioner. I was looking for a white noise machine that would block out the loud behemoth and obnoxious stomping upstairs. Neighbors, am I right -__-? The kid upstairs LOVES to skip, by the way. But enough about my neighbor troubles!!!

This machine has definitely helped. If it were a little less pricey, say around $30 or $40 , it would get more stars, but at $60 it's just okay. At first the noise was distracting, but with the machine on I was able to concentrate despite the loud click clack of hooves upstairs.

I'm a student and am permanently hibernating at home with my mountain of homework =], and this machine helps keep my attention on my studies. If you're an insomniac, this machine might also help, because even though I've had trouble sleeping, this machine makes me sleepy within ten minutes.

So the sound conditioner would have five stars if it were less pricey, but I'd say that it is *still* worth its price.

reviews.title: Great
reviews.text: Love it Everything I Asked for.  Works great and I sm very pleased with this . It helps me sleep and I recommend it highly

reviews.title: DS or SS? We have both.
reviews.text:
First, we bought the dual speed machine. After some trial and error, we only use it on the higher setting. The higher speed is louder/ and masks more noise. When we decided to buy a second one, I took a chance hoping that the single speed machine would be the same as the high speed setting on the dual speed machine. It is!  Just wanted to put that out there for anyone else wondering the same thing.

Thanks for reading, I hope this was helpful!

reviews.title: Jet Lag? Get Dohm! But be sure to get a power converter.
reviews.text:
I recently bought this because my wife wakes up at the slightest noise at night, I figured this would help her sleep. We just got back to Turkey from the US and I remembered that a steward recommended this to help you sleep when on international trips. Boy was she right. It is AMAZING.

I was completely unable to sleep before I turned this baby on--three nights of sleeplessness. Then all of a sudden I was sleeping like a baby. I couldn't recommend this more strongly. It's really amazing.

I have two other comments:
1) Don't buy the more expensive multi-speed, the device is made so you can adjust the volume by simply twisting the side. That is all you need.
2) It's recommended for international travellers, but it doesn't accept universal power input--it will not work with European voltage. What are they thinking? Is it that hard to make a special unit for the international traveller? They could slap another 30 bucks on the price and it would be worth it. Fortunately as an American living in Turkey I already had a converter, but if you don't have one you better get one before travelling.

So buy this now, and be sure to buy a converter as well. When I listen to the noise I would never believe it would work, but now both me and my wife are devotees--and not just because now I can go to the bathroom without waking my wife.

reviews.title: worth the money - nice sound, never sounds like static
reviews.text: I bought this for my first baby, now 2 years old.  This product is durable and seriously built with quality in mind.  The sound is a really nice white noise, not static or worse yet, feedback, like the cheap one I bought for baby #2.  (First Years brand, which I've found to be consistently terrible.)  I just got another one of the Marpacs for baby as a replacement and wish I had just done so to begin with.  My sister also uses the same one in her apartment because she loved ours.  This is the one.

reviews.title: BEST White noise maker ever! BEST BEST BEST!
reviews.text: This is hands down the BEST white noise maker I have ever used. I wish I had found this years ago. I was so tired of the unnatural sounded "tracks" from my other ones. This does not run on a track and just sounds better and is much more relaxing. If you are on the fence I say give it a try. You can always return it if you don't like it.

reviews.title: so far, so good
reviews.text: after reading many reviews and looking at similar products from other brands, I settled on this one. didn't want to spend a ton on the two speed but also wanted the "soundness" of the quality of the dohm.  I like the twisting features on the top that allow me to control the sound a bit. overall I am very happy with this. it provides just enough white noise in our small house for my baby to stay asleep but doesn't seem too loud/obnoxious.  hope it lasts!

reviews.title: son of a B*****: I wish I invented this!
reviews.text:
Whomever invented this is a F...n genius! I had a family mbr, a girl in her late teens, living with me for a few months. I was happy, only to find out that she sleeps with her phone like it's a man in her bed, and talks on it all night at almost full voice volume. No matter what I did, she wouldn't quite down enough. So I bought this. I figured, what could I lose? I was already losing sleep, so if this didn't work I'd just lose more sleep.

I turned it on and realized how loud it is. The thing is that it's a relaxing loudness. The white noise sounds airy, which makes sense because it actually sucks in air and blows it back out. It was so loud I couldn't put it right next to me on the night stand. (The directions specifically say to put it away from you in middle of room.) So, I followed the directions and actually put it near the opposite wall, which is in between my room and the room where the teenager stayed.

Long story short, it worked!!!!!!!!!!!! I slept like a baby with this thing on. If you have a teen or a noisy neighbor, this is your answer. I recommend this for anyone w/ problems w/ outside noise. What do you have to lose? If it doesn't work, give it away or return it. In the end, the teen left, so I'm home free again and don't use this anymore. But I have it packed away, ready for when I need it again.

reviews.title: Sound Machine
reviews.text: This machine is invaluable for a sound sleep.  I recommend it to all my friends who have trouble with noise when trying to get a good night's sleep.

reviews.title: Wonderful!
reviews.text: If anyone is looking for a white noise device, don't bother with the electronic/digital options.  Like others have said, I too get annoyed when the digital track loops, causing a hiccup in playback.  Since this is mechanical, you have a steady, natural sound that will drown out most noise.  I can't hear my wife talking to me in the hallway when this is on!  Helps my 6 month old sleep so well, we are buying another for my 3 year old, to help her sleep too.  Can't go wrong with this!

reviews.title: Love the sleep I'm getting
reviews.text:
The Marpac DOHM-SS Sound Screen & Sleep Mate Sound Conditioner - SLEEPMATE is exactly what I was looking for.

I've looked at fans, but many are making them "whisper quiet" now so they aren't generating enough noise to mask sounds from the upstairs neighbor, the guy coming home at 2am playing rap music with the car windows open, or my neighbors extremely squeaky a/c unit fan that's right under my bedroom window.

This does. It covers it all. I unboxed it, set it up in the bedroom and ran it immediately so I would "get used to it" before attempting to go to sleep. Every time I passed the open bedroom door I heard it and by the time I went to sleep it was a familiar sound.

So far it's running just fine and right now I'm very pleased with it.

reviews.title: We own 4 of these...
reviews.text: ...No kidding!  One for us, one each for our toddlers, and one for the new baby.  They work great, and probably will last forever.  Love the quality of the sound and the fact that it's mechanical so no loops, jumps, pauses, etc.  It's not cheap, but the quality is great.  And it's very adjustable, with the holes on the top and on the side.

reviews.title: AMAZING
reviews.text: Comforting soft white noise that soothes anyone to sleep. And is loud enough to really block extra noise out! I will be buying an extra for our room. My baby uses ours now and loves it. She has been sleeping longer since we bought it.

reviews.title: Soothing white sound - but no volume control
reviews.text: This is the second Marpac unit I have owned. The first one developed an annoying rattle after a couple of years use, so this is the replacement. The first unit was used in a bedroom with carpet, and the volume was fine on a night stand beside the bed. Since we have moved, the new unit is in a bedroom with hardwood floors and the volume is so loud we had to put the unit on the other side of the room on a table farthest away from the bed. It is still very loud, even with all the air ports closed down. I think an electronic unit with an adjustable volume may be better suited for our environment, so keep that in mind when choosing your type of sound machine.

reviews.title: what I hoped for
reviews.text: I had been looking for this for at least 15 years when my old 2 speed sleepmate started going bad. Tried this and loved it. It helps drown out the noises that come from the outside.  Of course don't try talking between rooms , it doesn't work that well.

reviews.title: Helps me sleep soundly
reviews.text: I use this machine for sleep, but you can use it for anything: office, baby's room, or to study with.  It really drowns out any outside noise like the TV, snoring, birds tweeting, etc. You can twist the sides and turn the top to change the sound/volume. Make sure you keep it on a smooth level surface since any tilt will change the sound to a "motor" sound- not the white noise sound that you were hoping for.  There is also a card in the package to register your product through the mail or online.

reviews.title: NOT what it seems!
reviews.text: I got this because we wanted to finally rid the fans in our house (its coooold in winter!), but it is NOT loud at all. Maybe if I was in the middle of the woods (like up north) ONLY then this would come into use..or maybe a hotel, maybe. THIS MACHINE ISN'T EVEN AS LOUD AS A FAN ON LOW! crazy i tell you. Definitly not worth the money.

reviews.title: Privacy
reviews.text: It does exactly what I wanted and I like that the cord is long enough to reach outside the office! Perfect for my practice!

reviews.title: great little machine
reviews.text: The Sleepmate 580A is a nice little machine - generally loud enough when fully opened.  Some minor adjustment available - for loudness or for the sound pitch.  Small and portable.  Some nights I wish it were louder, but overall, I'm satisfied.

reviews.title: use it at our office
reviews.text: My wife and I are therapists. We use this in our waiting room; it works great!  You can't hear a word out there.  In a business where confidential information is being passed, this product is very effective.  5 stars,

reviews.title: Two defective units in two months; but it works okay now.
reviews.text:
I ordered one of these units at the end of December.  I loved the white noise it created but within three weeks it started making a rattling sound that woke me up in the night.  I returned to Amazon for a replacement.  I got the replacement at the end of January.  Five weeks later, the replacement started making the same rattling sound.  Now I am past the 30 day exchange period and am stuck having to pay to send it to the company for repairs.  I really do think the sound it creates is great for sleeping (no, not loud enough to cover other loud noises).  But the quality is really lacking.

Edit: I was able to find a work around for the second defective unit. If I propped it up on an angle, the rattling stopped. It is now 2016 and I still have it and use it every night. So, it worked out in the end.

reviews.title: Can't sleep without it!
reviews.text: If you like to have white noise while you sleep and you don't care for the digital rainstorm/ocean waves type, this is definitely the product you want.  I was a little concerned to get this older model at first but it works great and I haven't missed the additional features.

reviews.title: Sleep mate sound conditioner
reviews.text: I have been using a sleep mate to help me sleep for 50 years and all my children use them too. I added a new grandchild so had to add a new sleep mate and this one is great.

reviews.title: Not half-bad...
reviews.text: This unit makes a pleasant background noise, similar to the "whoosh" of a well-made fan.  It has two speeds, high and low.  I find that the high speed produces a tone that I find distracting, so I use it on the low speed.  It isn't loud enough to fill the entire room, so you might consider purchasing two of these if you are serious about screening out sounds from the outside world.  You'll want to place each one between where you work/sleep/read/whatever and the door or window that is letting noise into your room.  It does seem to work better if you elevate it off of the floor by placing it on a table, stand, or chair.  I find that it compliments my portable fan nicely.  With the two of them placed strategically in my living room, I can work or read without being disturbed by common street noises or the conversations of my neighbors.

reviews.title: It is still working!
reviews.text:
Works well, very loud sound masking ability.  Works if you want white noise as background.  Often used in professional settings.

Ten years later after nightly use, it still works. Great product.

reviews.title: Releases A LOT of electromagnetic radiation
reviews.text:
I love the sound of this product.  However, I am giving it one star because it releases A LOT of electromagnetic radiation.  I use a Gauss meter to measure electromagnetic radiation for all my electrical objects -- especially the ones I sleep next to for many hours.

I measured the Marpac Sleepmate and was atonished to see the meter go off the charts.  I thought maybe I had a defective sound machine so I checked another Marpac Sleepmate and found the same problem.  I have an electronic (non mechanical) sound machine (Sound Oasis) and it showed very little electromagnetic radiation.

I prefer the sound and the quality of the Marpac to the Sound Oasis, but the amount of radiation is just too high to justify its use for so many hours at night.

reviews.title: Solved a problem
reviews.text: My office has a lot of hardwood flooring; therefore, voices tend to carry into the next room easily.  I purchased this product to help muffle voices.  I purchased two and they have effectively done so.  I am happy with the product.

reviews.title: Will work for some
reviews.text: This is one of those rare products I think where you just have to try it for yourself to see if it works for your particular circumstances.  When I first got the machine, I thought I was going to be disappointed.  It was smaller than I imagined, and not quite as loud as I imagined.  My particular problem involves rather loud noises in a neighboring room by someone who likes to scream late at night.  Putting the machine close to my head, the sound does indeed drown out for the most part that particular sound.  I do have to put it right above my head though in order for it to be loud enough to drown out other noises.  I have noticed however, it does not drown out all noises, particularly low bass sounds and things like footsteps and clicking sounds.  If your trying to drown out the noise of a TV... it might work fine whereas the sounds of someone playing lots of bass music it won't work.  In addition, whereas some people will find the sounds the machine makes to be soothing... others will find it more irritating than the noises they were trying to block.  It sounds almost exactly like one of those bathroom air vent fans.  So, in my particular case, while it drowned out the person who was screaming and I found the sounds relaxing, now the person who I was trying to drown out continuously screams about hearing my Sleepmate machine and so I'm forced to turn it off in the middle of the night and still get no sleep.

reviews.title: Not conducive to good sleep
reviews.text: There is a fine line between white noise and just plain noise. For me, this product fell into the "just plain noise" category.  No matter how I adjusted it, it did not provide a comfortable background noise that allowed me to sleep. I returned it and the return process was very easy.  Amazon is to be commended for that.

reviews.title: Does not drown out coworker in cube next door.
reviews.text: I have a coworker in the cubicle next to mine who chomps on gum for hours on end without break. It's quite disgusting and makes me ill. I bought this machine to drown her out. Unfortunately, I can still hear her incessant gum smacking and obnoxious chewing sounds despite the fact that this machine is so loud that it makes my head hurt.

reviews.title: Works great
reviews.text: Allows for a good nights sleep with white noise. Just what we wanted . Covers all those outside noises that can keep you awake.

reviews.title: Can YOU hear this thing that only makes ONE sound?
reviews.text: The volume range for this is so narrow it doesn't make a difference how "high" or "low" you adjust it. Manufacturer claims this device makes many sounds--it makes one. And don't bother trying to use it as a privacy-helper in the bathroom--you might as well just turn on the faucet for all the help it provides.

reviews.title: love it!!!
reviews.text: i have to admit that when i first started using this product i wasn't used to the noise, but now that i've been using it i love it!  i just can't sleep now without it.  plus, i love how easy it is to pack and take with me where ever i go (the cord is also really long).  the only thing i would change is that the product didn't come with instructions, so at first i couldn't figure out how to change the volume (there is no volume dial).  i did eventually find out that the volume is adjusted by turning the top of the product so that less noise is coming out of the top holes.  i would definitely recommend this product.

reviews.title: Marpac sleep ate 580A
reviews.text: Wonderful!! The sleepmate is loud just like a fan. Can drowned out anything. I got mine because of dogs barking in our neighborhood. The only thing I dont like is there is a soft not loud rattle sound that I can hear when it's running coming from inside the sleepmate. You can adjust the sound just how you like it from low to soft. I would recommend this product to e everyone!

reviews.title: Works well but has a short lifespan
reviews.text: I had to buy a new sound condition because my other one broke after 2 years of use. I was a little disappointed with the life of this product, but I need it for my 2-year old daughter to sleep so I bought it again.

reviews.title: He sleeps!
reviews.text:
My son is a super light sleeper.  A plane flies overhead and he wakes up.
Walking around the house, he wakes up.
Flushing the toliet two stories down, he wakes up.

Finally something that drowns out all the noise, and he sleeps through.

BTW my husband loves it too.

reviews.title: Great sound machine
reviews.text: This sound machine works wonderful for our 3 month old baby. It has 2 volumes, but one sound. Its a good size that will travel well. It's small enough that I can pick it up with one hand.

reviews.title: Buy your own
reviews.text: You can't have mine. I do love this product as it enables me to sleep.  it is adjustable, small, works great to help me sleep.  I just wish I didn't have to get up and go to work.  My wife tells me about thunder storms that have awakened her - I never heard them.  Happy sleeping!

reviews.title: does what it is supposed to
reviews.text: Very basic sound machine with steady fairly loud noise. You moderate the noise by turning the plastic casing to cover or reveal the slits in the side and the holes on top. The noise is either moderate or loud (there is no quiet).  The sound is a steady thrum without any variation.

reviews.title: Great for baby
reviews.text: We just moved to a condo next to a construction site, and this is a must for helping our baby nap during the day.

reviews.title: Can't sleep without it
reviews.text: I bought two of these.  My daughters family with babies uses this model as well.  I bought the one speed which is the loudest speed on the two speed unit.  Don't waste your money on the two speed ($10 more).  You will only use the high speed to mask noise.  My sisters all use this model right next to their heads to mask snoring noise.  You will sleep like a baby.  Ahhhhhhhh!!!  Zzzzzzzzz!

reviews.title: Just what I needed!!!
reviews.text: My husband and I sleep with a fan that makes noise because we're both light sleepers.  After going through 3 cheap fans, we bought this product - the single speed version - and absolutely LOVE it!  It is a bit louder than a small fan on medium speed, but makes a similar "white noise" that we've been used to and is exactly what I had hoped for.  Not sure if I'd pay the extra $ for the two-speed, and I'm thankful that I didn't since this one is perfect for us.  HIGHLY recommended!!

reviews.title: sent me wrong model.
reviews.text: Ordered the model with high and low control buttons i was sent the model with on and off button only. white noise? Heck, this thing sounds like a hurricane. who can sleep through that. i live out of the usa had to have this sent to my sister stateside and she mailed it to me here overseas. Disappointing. they should check the models against orders before shipping out. sending it back from here would cost more than what i paid for it.

reviews.title: Great white noise machine
reviews.text: We use this sound machine for our 9 month old's room to help him sleep through the random sounds that we can hear through the walls in our apartment. It works really well, is very portable, and our son now associates the sound with calming down and falling asleep. The only reason I didn't give it 5 stars is because I wish it could adjust to be a little louder than it is, although it seems to be working out for our little guy regardless. Maybe the sleep machine that is the next step up from this one and is more expensive is louder. I'm not sure. This one has good volume, but it isn't as loud as the fan I had been using before we bought this so that's why I noticed the difference. Overall, this is a great little machine and has been worth every penny for us.

reviews.title: heather
reviews.text: great product, just the right amount of volume and white noise. My husband wants to buy another one just to keep in our suitcase so we always have it when traveling!

reviews.title: Much easier than a fan
reviews.text: I have been very pleased with my "white noise maker".  I did not want a machine that plays waterfalls, I needed a white noise that was easy to use at home and to take traveling.  I agree with the person who said it takes about a week to get used to this sound conditioner, however it does have variable pitches and noise levels you can adjust.  It sounds more like the air conditioners in hotels than it does a fan, which is fine.  It is loud enough to block most noises. I recommend this product!

reviews.title: Great for Baby and Kids Room
reviews.text:
I know they have fuzzy teddy bears that replicate noises like the mother's womb. And sound machines that sound like the ocean on a broken record.

But when it comes to getting your kids to sleep, you need something to block out the noisy neighbors who have a tendency to drink, slam car doors and have really interesting conversations about meat at 2 o'clock in the morning.

I did research for weeks before getting this. Now I already have an air purifier from Honeywell that sounds like a jet engine landing and works really well for one of the kids room, but I wanted something as effective but without the energy draw.

It WORKS FANTASTIC.

It is light, easy to pack in a suitcase and uses barely any electricity.

reviews.title: Pleased customer
reviews.text: We have had our Marpac Sleepmate 580A sleep machine for approximately three weeks now and are very satisfied with the results.

reviews.title: Simple But Effective
reviews.text: I use an air conditioner to cool my room during the summer months & of course got used to the noise at night.  The Sleepmate is an excellent replacement for my air conditioner for the winter months.  I bought the single speed model & did'nt see the need to spend extra for a dual speed.  It sounds just like a small window air conditioner but not as loud.  I would highly recommend this product but I wish they could lower the price a little $45 is quite high!

reviews.title: Oops, someone forgot the listening test
reviews.text: It's well built, I'll say that. Quality construction. But apparently no one gave it a listening test before putting it on the market. What does it sound like? A cheap bathroom fan comes to mind. Another shortcoming is that the volume range is very limited. C'mon, Marpac, you can do a better job. A better alternative, and much cheaper is the 12-hour brown-noise recording available on YouTube.

reviews.title: Perfect machine
reviews.text:
I was looking for a simple white noise machine to replace using a box fan shoved in the corner of my bedroom.  This fits the bill perfectly.  It just makes a very fan-like noise (which works for me) and isn't fussy with nature sounds or soft music.  Since I started using it, I've slept better than I have in a long while even with my old box fan.
It's small and light enough to pack away for travel as well.

reviews.title: Sound Machine Sounds Good
reviews.text: This Marpac 580A does a nice job of substituting for the fan noise I am used to during Summer.  Although this model is only one speed the volume of the noise can be adjusted through both the top and the side.  It doesn't block out my wife's snoring and it doesn't blow away the dog's gas but I guess no product is perfect.  I am pleased with the Marpac 580A.

reviews.title: Great product
reviews.text: I work nights so sleeping during the day is important.  The sleepmate makes a great background noise and drowns out disturbing sounds.  I have had one for 5 years and use it daily without any problems.  I like is so much, that I bought two more in case they ever stop making them!

reviews.title: Does the trick.
reviews.text: I needed a sound masking device for my office.  This one is simple, solidly built, and works just fine.  I like that it is A/C powered.  The sound is consistent, not too electronic sounding, seems to be doing exactly what I needed it for.

reviews.title: okay
reviews.text:
I was really expecting this to mask more noise than it does based on the thousands of fabulous reviews.  I live in a dorm right now, and it's pretty difficult to get eight hours a night between doors slamming/girls giggling and screaming/music/my roommate deciding she has to dump everything from her shelves and reorganize the furniture, now, at 2:30am.

To be honest, this didn't mask any noise at all, even the small ones inside my room.  I can still hear my roommate typing 10 feet away from me, hear her coughing, hear noises outside my room, etc.  It didn't really help in the noise-masking department whatsoever.

That being said, it does provide a constant noise that I can focus on instead of being constantly distracted and irritated by all the other ones.  I have to concentrate though -- like I said, it doesn't cover other noises.

reviews.title: Masks Noise Well
reviews.text: We purchased this for our light-sleeping toddler when our new baby was born. He was having trouble sleeping through the baby's overnight cry sessions, and we were hoping this machine would mask the noise and allow him to get the rest he needed. It has! He's sleeping very well through the night -- even when the baby has particularly loud bouts of crying. It has a "softer" noise that is much more pleasant than radio static. He likes to set the level of the sound every night before he goes to bed. We're very happy with the purchase.

reviews.title: Sleeping again!
reviews.text: I have had both this model and the model with variable speed options.  Personally, I didn't find the extra cost for the 2 speed control worth it for my use.  This creates enough white noise comparable to my old box fan but is just a fraction of the size.  I have it on my night stand as I needed it to be close for maximum volume/drown out.  But thanks to this device, I no longer wake with all the night noises of the city.  Additionally, it easily fits in my suitcase which means I can get a good night sleep while on vacation as well!!  I loved this product so much I bought one for my kids to use since they were infants.  The first one I bought is 6 years old and running great still (knock on wood) and has been used every night since purchased and at naps once the kids were born.

reviews.title: Great for Kiddos! Exactly what I wanted
reviews.text: This is the second Sleepmate we have purchased. We have one in each of our kids rooms. Portable enough to travel too. Very pleased!

reviews.title: Works Great, Perfect for Travel
reviews.text: We bought the Marpac Sleepmate 580A to replace the fan we'd been using for years.  We both work second shift and white noise makes it possible for us to sleep through the morning neighborhood noise.  This is an excellent replacement for our fan.  The sound is louder, more uniform and can be adjusted to suit our preference.  It doesn't block out external sounds, but I don't think we  could sleep with something loud enough to do that.  It instead smooths out the background sound so you're not startled awake by sudden loud noises.  We travel frequently and brought the machine with us on our last trip.  We were very thankful to have it.

reviews.title: Good white noise maker
reviews.text: We used this for our baby when he was born. The white noise soothed him and helped him sleep, and it also drowned out ambient noise. I also have one in our room, to drown out street noises and my husband's snoring! It helps all of us sleep better. I like that it's cheaper than other white noise/ocean noise/rain noise makers out there, and works just as well. We ordered from this vendor and the noise maker came quickly, as ordered.

reviews.title: Excellent
reviews.text: I am very excited to have this. It sounds perfect. Now I can take this with me out of town instead of having to lug around a huge fan everywhere I go in order to get some sleep.

reviews.title: Loud fan white noise
reviews.text:
It's like having a super-loud fan in the room, without the air blowing. I love it; I think it blocks out neighbors and the TV in the other room and occasionally, even my husband's snoring. But he hates it, thinks it's too loud, and usually turns it off, which defeats the purpose. There's no volume control; you can twist the side and the top to alter the sound somewhat, so I made it lower instead of higher, but that wasn't enough to get my husband to leave it on.
I think it's much too loud to take to work in a cubicle setting.  I was hoping to take it in to drown out annoying co-workers, but I can't imagine everyone would put up with the sound and I'd be "requested" to turn it off.

reviews.title: Great sound machine!
reviews.text: This noise machine works really well! We went on vacation and shared a house with 3 other screaming babies and our baby slept through it all! It drowns out the noise outside of the room. It was a savior for us! It almost sounds like a window unit a/c -which is what we have at home so it was perfect! You can still hear things outside the room but not as loudly.

reviews.title: Great Sleep Machine
reviews.text: I had purchased the same product with two speeds, however, that was unnessesary.  This one with just the one speed was perfect!!!  We love the Sleepmate, and use it everyday!

reviews.title: It's good
reviews.text: It works well at blocking out noises especially if you work in a small office like mine where people can hear most of your conversations. Now we can have small meetings without breaching confidentiality.

reviews.title: You won't be disappointed!
reviews.text:
Do NOT waste your money on those electonic "sound machines" with the heart beats and waves crashing.  If what you are looking for is sound that fills the room and blends into the background, this is your machine.

I have had 3 electronic noise machines in the past 18 months, but since I bought this, it has been going strong nightly and a few hours during the day when my son takes a nap.

You will not regret this purchase. And we are going away this summer with friends so this will also be making the trip as we like our sleep while some of my friends like to stay up a little late :)

Nov. 8, 2012 update- still going strong with use every night for the past 19 months.  Great machine.

reviews.title: Happy household
reviews.text: I bought this machine for my mother, who lives with my sister in a four-generation household that includes my mom's nine-month-old great-granddaughter and three dogs. Although everyone is respectful of my mother's privacy, the walls are thin. Having this Sleepmate is now allowing her to sleep through the nighttime sounds and noises that previously woke her up. She (as well as me and the rest of the family) couldn't be more pleased! [[ASIN:B000LQI2S0 Marpac Sleepmate 580A Sound Conditioner Single Speed]]

reviews.title: Sleeping again!
reviews.text: This little machine has been a life saver.  Noises from outside and inside the house (long term house guest that snores) were keeping us up.  Based on the positive reviews here on Amazon, I ordered this and it's worked perfectly.  We don't have to set it to anywhere near the total volume for it to drown out those annoying sounds that keep you awake.  It's also small enough that we plan to take it with us when traveling.  Great purchase and well worth the money!

reviews.title: Stopped working after 14 months
reviews.text: Took the cover off and it's a fan inside.  No user serviceable parts.  For that kind of money I expected a longer lifespan.

reviews.title: I sleep like a baby with this.
reviews.text: My roommate is very loud and my walls are very thin, yet somehow this magic machine makes me feel like I'm miles away. It's a great noise-canceller. I couldn't sleep without it.
