reviews.title: White Noise Machine
reviews.text: This is a great product. Being retired, we use it to block out morning noises in the neighborhood that awaken us before we are ready.

reviews.title: Great price for a great machine
reviews.text: I recently purchased the SleepMate so that I could block incoming and outgoing noise from my room. I did not expect the results to be so good. Even though the product description states that there is only one noise level, you can adjust the machine by opening and closing the side slits. The product works great. The white noise is very helpful in blocking unwanted noise such as birds chirping and is relaxing so it helps when you go to sleep. It is sleek and non-obtrusive in the environment. People in the therapy business should definitely have one of these. They keep your conversations private and don't disturb your appointments. Overall, it is a great machine for a great price.

reviews.title: Love our sleep machine
reviews.text: Bought a 2nd one of these for our infant and I'm convinced it helps them stay asleep. Our  1st one of these was the dual speed but the single speed works just fine. I would recommend saving a few bucks and going w/ the single speed if I were buying another one.

reviews.title: Bought another for 2nd baby!
reviews.text: My first born would know it's time to sleep when this was on. So a good nights sleep can be taken anywhere, hotels, trips, and grandmas house. My now 3 yr old didn't want to give hers up so I had to get another for her brother. It also hides housecsounds after bedtime, no need to worry about waking the baby.

reviews.title: Sleepmate 580A
reviews.text: Sounds just like a fan but blows no air, so it is great for winter if you are used to a fan.I have used this for over 20 years and this purchase is an addition to one I already own which still works after all those years.Believe it or not,this unit is made in the U.S.A which means something to me.If you need soothing noise to sleep,this is a good buy,John Sponsler.

reviews.title: Useful and comforting
reviews.text: First used to block sound for day-sleeper, we later bought another to help with baby fussing not waking our toddler.  Now, in a new house, we bought another for the older kids room, so they're not bothered by noises of doing dishes or watching TV at night.  I thought the "one in every room, can't sleep without it" was ridiculous when I first investigated the product, but now I agree.  The world needs a little background white noise.  I wish it were cheaper, but I'm willing to pay it (several times, apparently).  I recommend it to everyone I can.

reviews.title: Very Pleased
reviews.text: I was surprised that this single speed unit has adjustable sound control by opening and closing the openings in the sides. My daughter finds it very soothing and it doesn't bother other family members. Quick delivery and very pleased with my purchase.

reviews.title: this is my 3rd one
reviews.text: we have 3 of these in our house, 2 of them are over 10 years old.  my son has one in his room and we have 2 in the master.  great white noise, just sounds like air blowing.  use them to sleep and drown out random night noises.  great product, worth the price, they last forever.

reviews.title: Marpac Sleepmate
reviews.text: We have a large family in a small house, we have a Sleepmate in every bedroom and in an office.  They are wonderful.  We were addicted to fans but they get cold in the winter.  This is perfect solution.  Wish I had them sooner.  Well worth the price.

reviews.title: Life-changing
reviews.text: is what my roommate calls it. Woke him up 3 weekends in a row and not since buying this for him. Great product, on the highest setting doesn't seem loud but really drowns out the sound.

reviews.title: Does the job, but why no variable speed?!
reviews.text:
My girlfriend and I moved into a great new apartment recently. The only downside is a loud neighbor, a night owl who crashes around in her apartment at midnight, leaves for work at 1am, comes home at 4am, then takes the garbage out.

The noise machine creates a soothing blanket of whooshing air that covers up our neighbour. However, why oh why doesn't Marpac make it with a dial to adjust the speed of the fan? Honestly, it is just a little too loud - we'd love to be able to dial it down a bit. If we wanted something this loud that we could just leave the bathroom extractor fan on all night.

Marpac does make a more expensive model with two speed settings, but why not just make one model with several settings (like every desk fan on the market, for instance). The people who buy this product are most likely sensitive to noise already, so why not give them the ability to adjust the noise generator to their own specifications?

I guess Marpac are the only people out there making these things, so they have no competition and thus no reason the improve the product. One model, with multi-speed setting (more than just two!), would seem to be an obvious next-step for them.

Still, if noise is a problem where you live, this will do the trick.

reviews.title: Love it! But Pricey.
reviews.text: Super product! We can't sleep without some white noise and this is loud enough to drown out most household and outside noises. I like its compact size as it will be perfect to take on overnight trips. Although I thought it was expensive, I will likely buy at least one more.

reviews.title: Life saver!
reviews.text: This is our second white noise machine purchase.  Our daughter would not give hers up for her little brother so we bought a new one.  Our floors are squeaky, we live near an airport and also have a lot of helicopter traffic by our home.  This has helped our son sleep so much better...and our first one did the same for our daughter!  Definitely recommend this product!

reviews.title: A great sleep aid
reviews.text: This is a great sleep aid, I had tried other white noise systems before but this is the one that works..

reviews.title: very good buy
reviews.text: i have slept with a fan running all my life.so when i seen this i had to have it .i am so glad i bought this sleepmate.i sleep like a baby now.i am a very light sleeper and any noise and im up.this cancels out any noise so i dont get desturded anymore.its not that loud but it doesnt need to be for it to work.i mean i have had a fan on high running every nite for 35 years and this thingy worked for me.and my electric bill went down about 20 dollars.you need one of these if you have to sleep with noise.

reviews.title: Perfect for Children
reviews.text: This is a great sound machine to help children sleep better.  I have one for each of my kids and it is perfect to help them sleep without waking at all the sounds of our neighborhood.  It is small, compact, and easy to use!

reviews.title: Don't Waste Your Money
reviews.text: My husband and I are both nurses and routinely work night shifts. Whoever is not sleeping during the day is running our household with three children. I purchased the Marpac because of its wonderful reviews and actually kind of "blew off" the few negatives I read. What a mistake. While it is small and has varying pitches of sound easily adjusted by twisting the outer shell of the unit, it is absolutely NOT loud enough to cover everyday household noise. During the day I "slept", I heard my children playing, the microwave and kitchen doors closing, our garage door going up and down, the garbage truck, and the school bus (just to name a few). This unit is perhaps suitable if you only need it at night as white noise to sleep better, but if you are a shift worker who needs it to cover noise during the day, skip it. I am purchasing another Honeywell fan to replace the one I've had for the past 10 years and cost me $15.

reviews.title: sleeping very peacefully
reviews.text: I am a very light sleeper and we live in a half a double on a busy street, and this sound conditioner has really drowned out the sounds of the neighbors and the traffic. It has only been a couple of weeks but I use it every night and feel well rested ever since I purchased this... I wish I bought it much sooner!

reviews.title: Marpac Sleepmate 580A Sound Conditioner
reviews.text: This product works very well at neutralizing background noise so you can sleep better. I have sleep apnea, and trying to fall back asleep after waking up during the night can be very difficult. This machine helps me to fall asleep, and stay sleeping. The price was fair for this well made machine.

reviews.title: Great Sound, No Fuss
reviews.text:
After using an older model in my office (I'm a therapist). I wanted one for sleeping at home.

This doesn't allow for much customization. You can turn it slightly to adjust the airflow and get slightly different sounds... but it's pretty straightforward. Volume is not adjustable. It does a great job drowning out household noises and I love the sound. I find it soothing, and similar to a small hairdryer (without the high-pitched tinney sound.)

Our toddler ended up getting it from us- because he needed it more. And I miss it!

Our friends' children spent the night here and they also thought it was really cool and looked into getting one too. So if you're looking for a straightforward white noise machine, that is pleasant and without "glitching" I recommend this one highly! If you're looking for a machine that will allow for volume/tone adjustment, this probably isn't the right one for you.

reviews.title: This product is my saving grace
reviews.text: I bought the sleep mate about two months ago.  Before the sleep mate, I had tried other noise machines, as well as ear plugs.  The other machines only distracted me and kept me awake (falling asleep to the sounds of a thunderstorm?  Really?).  As soon as I turned this little gadget on, I was immediately soothed.  It sounds just like my air conditioner (I live in NYC where window units still exist).  All the street sounds that normally keep me awake (car alarms, horns, the occasional screaming fight) seemed as if they were happening miles away.  It was amazing.  If you're a light sleeper, get this product.  It'll change your life.[[ASIN:B000LQI2S0 Marpac Sleepmate 580A Sound Conditioner Single Speed]]

reviews.title: Last Forever!
reviews.text:
I have a model 454 that must be at least 30 years old, and it keeps on going.  I've tried electric white noise makers over the years, but they just aren't the same.  Can't really explain why, they just aren't.  When mine finally conks out, I'm definitely going to get another one!  I live in a noisy area, a bad one too with gunshots, loud cars, noisy neighbors and the like, and this unit does an amazing job keeping the noises down.

Just did a Google search for the model 454, I got this...
"It is billed as, "Sleep-Mate" by Marpac of Wilmington, N.C.. It is model number 454.
This item is circa the 1960's. "

1960's!!!  Wow, guess it's lasted longer than I thought!

reviews.title: Marpac noise machine
reviews.text:
We have used these for years.  Now, our grown children are addicted.  They work flawlessly and forever.  The Amazon seller shipped right away.  We have dual speed and single speed, and the single speed works very well since the sound "volume" is adjustable on both models.  Save the $10 extra for dual speed.

UPDATE:  We take this on vacation.  Can't sleep without it.  They just keep working and working.....bzzzzzzz

reviews.title: Too loud
reviews.text:
My intent for buying this was for use in exam rooms in a clinic to drown out outside noise when the pt was waiting in the room. I 'trialed' it in my office which lasted less than 3 hours. It was much too loud, and annoying. I ended up with a headache, along with my co-worker outside my office. She referred to it as "like being in a wind tunnel"
It worked as stated, I imagined it would be a more pleasant sound for some reason.

reviews.title: Love it!
reviews.text: My husband and I have had a Sleepmate sound maching for years (same machine for over 15 years) and we love it.  We bought two more to put in our kids rooms (ages 5 and 9 months).  The little one doesn't wake the 5 year old in the night and vice versa.  These machines are wonderful.  We also take them with us on trips to help everyone sleep better away from home.  It's a nice steady sound and doesn't sound "electronic" like some of the other types of noise machines.

reviews.title: The ratings were right!
reviews.text: I live off of a very busy street and my home happens to be right next to both a shipping train line and public transit train line. Add the noise of a snoring husband, and I was desperate. Earplugs kept hurting my ears when they were not giving me infections. I slept so well the very first night. Even my dog seemed to sleep better. I am so very happy with this purchase.

reviews.title: Puts me and my Daughter Asleep
reviews.text: Since having this product I've noticed a big difference in helping me and especially my daughter get to and stay asleep. I used to use a small fan as I've known about the benefits of white noise and sleep for years. But with the winter having come I didn't want her to get chilled. I also have experienced mechanical vs. recorded white noise and there is no contest in favor of the mechanical. After a while the recorded will actually bug you and wake you up. In any case unless this product suddenly breaks down I have nothing but good things to say about it. I find it funny that some have complained it doesn't make enough sound. I actually find it a bit loud but keep it on the other side of the room as suggested and it works great. I heartily recommend this product to anyone needing help with sleeping and or blocking other distracting noises. Sweet Dreams : )

reviews.title: Noise not so white after 6 months
reviews.text: I purchased this product just under 7 months ago.  At first it worked normally, projecting a smooth white noise sound.  Recently the white is being drowned out by a grinding/crackly type noise.  As it is too late to return with Amazon, I will be asking the manufacturer for a replacement.

reviews.title: I luv this product!!!!!!
reviews.text: I just love this machine since it cancels out all the other annoying  background noise. This product is definitely a white noise machine & for anyone concerned about this product emitting anything potentially harmful I put mine on the floor next to my bed & the sound is loud enough & perfect for me to drown out traffic, bird & airplane noise. The only thing I am sad about is not knowing about this product decades ago since it is a really wonderful product. The sound of the machine sounds sort of like a regular fan or a bathroom fan. For me it's the perfect sound machine & makes it where I can fall asleep with ease & just what I was hoping for.

reviews.title: Just what I needed!
reviews.text: I am extremely satisfied with this product. I was looking for a sound that would mimic my air conditioner, and this is it! I sleep with this machine right near my head and I've been sleeping more soundly than ever. Highly recommended, well worth the money.

reviews.title: quiet please!
reviews.text:
I bought the Sleepmate 580A mainly because of reading the positive reviews.
The product works well for me when I want to take a nap or go to bed at night to drown our or mask noises coming from adjacent apartments and parking lot noises.
I normally turn on my bedside radio to try to mask outside noise but the radio does not work as well as the Sleepmate.

reviews.title: The best-- just wish it were louder
reviews.text: There is no better product on the market that I know of. Far better than digital devices. If you are an extremely sensitive sleeper, you may need two.

reviews.title: Awesome
reviews.text: This replaced having a loud fan in my room for sound ... no more blowing dust ... the sound is perfect for me to sleep!  Just luv it!

reviews.title: product
reviews.text: I love this soundmaker. I've ordered a couple of them. Some as gifts. It allows me to watch TV after my husband goes to bed...because he is such a light sleeper. He complained at first that it was too loud. If he would use his eyes and not his mouth and read the directions he would have seen it has a volume control on it. I didn't say anything..he hee, so I can hear the TV in the den when he goes to bed YEA!!!

reviews.title: Sleep...how I have missed you!
reviews.text: I purchased this product because the amount of noise in my neighborhood is unreal.  It seems like there are dogs barking all night (and they sound like they are right in my backyard), people with loud exhausts and stereo systems hauling butt through the streets and endless parties with bass booming.  Being a light sleeper, I was not getting very much sleep at night without the aid of sleeping pills, which I really don't like to take.  So, I purchased this machine.  The machine is easy to adjust to different settings, it's small and looks decent in my room.  It does not drown out the above noises completely, but it makes the noises quieter.  Basically, if there is racket going on outside, it seems far away, instead of like it's happening in my backyard!  So, I've finally been able to get a month's worth of good night sleeps!  :)

reviews.title: Fully adjustable, organic noise!
reviews.text: I love this noise machine.  When compared to speaker-based models, the noise is much more soothing.  For me it is plenty loud, and there are adjustments on the top and sides for volume and pitch, depending on your preferences.  I like it loud and low!  It's very easy to turn on with just the flip of a switch.  It's not quite as portable as some smaller devices, but it's better than lugging around a full-size fan!  We take them everywhere we go, especially for the kids.  I highly recommend it.

reviews.title: Love it!
reviews.text:
I need some sort of background noise to be able to sleep while my wife gets ready for work.  Normally, I turn the fan on, but it is too cold to do that in winter.

This provides the perfect white noise to allow me to sleep.  Not too loud, not too quiet...just right!

reviews.text: We used a baby noise machine previous to this one and it was not nearly as effective. Very effective.

reviews.text: This is a perfect replacement for the desk fan she used every day and night (especially in the winter months when we don't need more cold, dry air moving around!). If we put it in the closet or bathroom and shut the door, it was tolerable.  I gave this sound machine 5 stars based on its effectiveness for my daughter.

reviews.title: very happy
reviews.text: I got this product for my 8 month old daughter.  She had trouble staying asleep because of noisy neighbors. After we got this she has been sleeping very soundly!

reviews.title: simple and straightforward does the trick
reviews.text: We purchased this item to use in my son's room to generate white noise while he sleeps.  We had been using a small fan but with the advent of cooler weather, didn't want to keep running it.  I like that the unit is very small and simple.  I think that it helps create a 'layer' of sound that helps other household noises and street noise stay more in the background.  So far, so good.  It turns out we have a friend who has the same model and has been using it for years.  We hope that ours will be similarly durable and long lasting.  We plan to even pack with us for longer trips!

reviews.title: Could not live without!!!
reviews.text: This product is perfect for apartment or city living.  The adjustments allow you to change the pitch and volume.  It really covers the bumps and thumps like car doors slamming and people talking/walking!  My son and I both have one and I would recommend it to anyone, and I do!

reviews.title: Can't sleep without it
reviews.text: I'm not sure what I could say that hasn't already been said. I used to use a fan to help block the outside noise while I slept since I worked the night shift but the biggest problem with the fan was that I hated the air circulation because I would always wake up with a dry or sore throat. About ten years ago I came across the SleepMate 980 and bought one and I wished I had done it a LOT sooner. My 980 has been going strong for the last ten years but I just bought a SleepMate 580 as a backup just in case anything ever happens to my 980. I recently had a power outage that lasted about 8 hours during my sleep time and I realized how hard it is to sleep without it. For those who were unaware, the SleepMate 580 is exactly the same as the SleepMate 980 except it only has one speed - which is the equivalent of the high speed on the 980 (which is the only speed I use on my 980). Physically they are exactly the same and you wouldn't be able to tell them apart except for the on/off switch.

reviews.title: great white noise for baby
reviews.text:
I have been using fans for years to make "white noise" for my children while they slept. Our house is not very big and sound travels. The fans were good for the noise, but it seemed my baby kept waking up with a stuffy/runny nose. This product was a bit pricy, but I'm glad I bought it. We've had it for about a week and it is working wonderfully. I needed the sound to be pretty loud and it is. If you have a baby and are looking for a white noise effect to help them sleep-go ahead a get this-you'll be glad you did.
2/4/2014****update***
Well, we now own 3 of these. Just wanted to be a bit more helpful for someone out there whose machine might've stopped working like one of ours did. I got one of those tiny screw drivers for toys and unscrewed the bottom to get the top off. I then took some wd-40 and sprayed all the little fan parts and twirled the fan around manually for a while. Then I put it all back together and it started working again- whew! Saved myself $40.

reviews.title: As good as the original
reviews.text: This is the 4th sound machine I've bought.  Have them for different rooms and one for traveling.  My original was bought in 1980 and finally gave out.  this one is excellent.

reviews.title: Use Every morning!
reviews.text: When my husband gets up he turns on my machine to block out the morning(kid getting ready for school)noise. I am a very light sleeper and recently sent one to my daughter in college for her dorm!

reviews.title: perfect white noise
reviews.text:
This review is short and simple because I couldn't ask for a better product.
The Marpac Sound Screen is exactly what I was looking for. It doesn't come with an array of silly sounds: ocean, rain, jungle, etc. Instead, it produces a white noise which can be adjusted to produce a louder or softer tone as you prefer. It works as a great masking device for all general house noises. Couldn't be happier.

reviews.title: Too Loud!
reviews.text: I was disappointed with this sound machine. We had one years ago when our son was a baby, and it worked great. I loaned it to someone and never got it back, and finally replaced it with a different model. When that one finally died, I decided it was time to finally spend the money to get another Marpac. I read the reviews that cautioned about not being able to adjust the volume, and boy, were they right---even with all the adjustments cranked down, it was still far too loud for our small bedroom. It is well made and I know they last, but the sound was too intense. I'm thankful for Amazon's good return policy.

reviews.title: Good sound, but not loud enough.
reviews.text: Had high hopes for this. It's compact enough to travel with and only makes one sound...white noise. To that end, it is fine, but it isn't loud enough to block the external noise by our house. Plus, could still hear television downstairs even when running. Would have been great if the thing would have gone a little louder.

reviews.title: White Noise Slumber
reviews.text: Surprisingly effective and helps my sleep despite the constant NYC traffic buzz outside my second floor window on 7th avenue!

reviews.title: Great White Noise - Sounds Just Like a Fan
reviews.text: If you are one of those people who needs to fall asleep with some sort of white noise in the background then this product is for you. Normally I just leave a fan on all night purely for the sound, but in the winter that gets to be a little difficult so I turn to this little guy. It's rather heavy when you first hold it, but once you plug it in you can immediately tell that it produces the perfect white noise sounds that almost mimics a fan. There are some parts of it that turn/slide so you can make the noise loud/soft, but I tend to leave it on the softest level. The unit despite being heavy is small enough that you could easily throw it in an overnight bag if you're going to sleep over with the in-laws who snore or with the friends with noisy kids.

reviews.title: noise machine
reviews.text: Turned it on the first night and thought, "I paid for that?"  But not now that I sleep with fewer "wake ups,"  and if I do wake up I fall back to sleep almost immediately.  So I'm sold on it.  Nice too that my wife and I can't hear each other snoring.

reviews.title: Not loud enough
reviews.text: I live on a noisy street so I bought this for my baby's room to help her sleep but it wasn't loud enough. It may be loud enough for other people but it just didn't work out for me.

reviews.title: Really good basic white noise
reviews.text: I am somewhat of a white noise junkie. I have tried fans, electronic machines and even a nebulizer to achieve deeper uninterrupted sleep. I discovered this machine when I was visiting my sister's house and needed to put my baby down in the other room. She told me this machine had worked really well for she and her husband and so I bought one. My little one did really well with it running, and did not hear the mayhem of my neices's fourteen year old birthday party. It is a really basic machine. It has an on/off switch and twists to adjust the loudness of the noise. What I really like about it, although it can't be turned up as high as some of the electronic machines, is that the white noise is really truly white noise. I don't know if you have ever noticed but on some of the machines that allow you to choose a variety of noises, the white noise setting is on a sound loop and if you are lying awake and listening closely you can hear it. This is just good pure white noise. Not a recording of it. It is a great machine. It works for my baby and it works for me, and its not too big to throw in the suitcase for travel. Will be using this from now on. If you just need good basic white noise, this is the machine for you.

reviews.title: get this one, don't get 980a
reviews.text: My ex-roommate has the 980a and I have the 580a. 980a is $10 more and it has two options instead of one seen in the 580a. The sounds from 980a and 580a is very similar. It has a very constant noise (no recording/repeating sound) and they both work well to sleep or drown out the noise from outside. If you sleep in a small, decent size bathroom, 580a is loud enough for daily usage. I have the 580a and I have to cover all the holes to minimize the noise. It can be loud if I don't cover all the holes. Overall, $40 is good, I just hope it lasts a while, like a year or two.

reviews.title: Not effective against high and low range sounds
reviews.text: The device works as described, but unfortunately was ineffective against the problem I was trying to solve.  If the noise you want to block out is in a mid-range frequency (for instance constant engine noise, or music in another room), this will probably work well for you.  But my issue is the sound of garbage pick-up outside my NYC windows.  The high-frequency clinking of glass and the low-frequency truck noises cut right through the white noise.  I returned it.

reviews.title: Strill great after all these years.
reviews.text: My wife uses it as our white noise machine for sleeping. We had/have a previous model that is about 15 years old. My better half was afraid that it would die any day now. Knowing that she could not make it through the night without her machine, we had to order a backup...We love it.

reviews.title: can't sleep without a sound machine
reviews.text: This is a very basic sound machine.  White sound only.  One speed only.  It is a small blessing.  It is well worth the money.  I also have purchased other Marpac sound machines.  I usually only get the ones that are very basic.  This one fit that requirement very well.  Very basic.  Very functional.  Can't sleep without it.

reviews.title: Great sound machine
reviews.text: I got this sound machine before moving to Chicago, where I knew the noise would be quite different from the suburbs. It was one of the best buys I have made! It helps to drown out the sirens, garbage trucks, people and construction while sleeping. It is most efficient at drowning out the sound of people or TV, and I often use it while studying. A wonderful, nice little sound conditioner!

reviews.title: Nothing Else Like It!
reviews.text: Using the natural, steady sound of air movement, this device provides a consistent, room-filling, unobtrusive white noise like nothing else.  All of those little devices with digital recordings playing in loops are not even in the same class of product.  We have one for the nursery, one for our room, and one that I take on my road trips.  Small, durable.  Highest recommendation.

reviews.title: wonderful product
reviews.text: This is a groovy gizmo - makes enough white noise - compact size - super for travel too -

reviews.title: Best sound machine
reviews.text:
We have slept with a sound machine in the bedroom ever since we lived next to a hideously ill-behaved family and their sad, ignored beagles. Both the humans and the beagles were noisy and disturbing at many points during each evening and night. When we moved to a new home after 1 year of neighboring with these people/animals we kept the sound machine in the room as we had grown used to the pleasant white noise.
Having purchased many different types and brands of sound machines over the last 15 years, I can say that the Marpac Sound Conditioner is by far the best one ever.  The sound it produces is like having a fan on in the room, without having the cold air chilling the room during freezing Michigan winters. The sound is not a recording like so many sound machines have.  Sometimes those white noise recordings have an annoying audible loop noise that can be really irritating.  Not so with the Marpac unit. It actually produces the white noise when you turn it on, and it is a lovely, soothing, relaxing white noise that cancels out any distracting or disturbing noises from the sleeping area. The Marpac 580A is fine for a average/smaller sized bedroom.  I would recommend the Marpac 980A 2 speed unit for master bedrooms and larger sized sleeping areas.

reviews.title: Great product; very effective noise reduction
reviews.text: This is the premiere of sound machines.  Creates very loud (if desired) yet pleasant white noise.  Started out using in the baby's room, and now it is also a mainstay on all our trips.  It is really great for hotels or cramped quarters with relatives/friends!  We recently used on a trip with our friends; their toddler and dogs were one room over with very thin walls.  Nothing woke us the whole night thanks to this sound machine.  It's a little pricier than others out there but worth it for the quality.  I have baby #2 on the way and have purchased a second unit for his bedroom.

reviews.title: OMG!!! This the most awsomest white noise machine evar!!!
reviews.text: We've been using these for years. Softens noises from outside like cars & noisy neighbors, etc. We've tried some electronic noise machines but they became annoying b/c they are a sound sample that loops. You can actually hear the point that it starts over again. This is a soft continuous whir. Every bedroom in our house has one & we have an extra for travel.

reviews.title: Great Sound machine
reviews.text:
I am a horrible sleeper, one of those people who wakes up at every little noise.  I also work nights and needed to find a sound machine that would drown out the everyday noise of city living.  Prior to buying this sound machine, I had tried a few less expensive ones.  Not one of them met my needs.

After reading some reviews, I decided to purchase the Marpac Sound Conditioner SleepMate and I can honestly say that I love it.  I've had it for over a year and use it every day not only when I'm sleeping, but also whenever I need to focus.  Reading books and studying has become easier using this machine.  I am very happy with this purchase and will buy from the Marpac company again.

reviews.title: Pick this Sound Machine!!
reviews.text:
We purchased this for our baby who is now 7 months old. We give it a perfect 5 out of 5 because it is a great sound machine/white noise maker. It is running nearly all day because we put it on for him to sleep for his naps and through the night. It has worked flawlessly.
Our neighbor has three small boys and their play area is right outside our sons window. They can make quite a racket, but he sleeps right through it.
If you are looking for a way to either soothe yourself to sleep or block out noise, buy this sound machine.  It has proved helpful not only to use for our infant, but also for us on trips to family, relatives or even hotels. The white noise has soothed us all to sleep!

I have no cons to offer. We even are going to purchase another one for our room!

reviews.title: A sound sleep
reviews.text:
This is the 2nd Marpac 580A I have purchased in the last 3 years and have been very pleased with it.

The previous machine I purchase stopped working after 2 1/2 years due to a power surge so I bought this new one.

Would recommend to anybody that doesn't like sleeping in silence.

reviews.title: We're getting ready to purchase our third...
reviews.text: The proof is in our purchases...five years ago when my first son was born we purchased this soundmaker.  When my second arrived two years later, it was a no brainer that we would purchase another.  These soundmakers provide just enough white noise that it covers up extra sounds (barking dogs, siblings playing, etc.).  My fourth child is due in July, so we're getting ready to purchase our third.  The first one was purchased five years ago and is still going strong. We are very pleased with this product as you can tell by our loyalty.  I recommend this product with no hesitation.

reviews.title: a great gift
reviews.text: I purchased this item for a friend's birthday who has had difficulty sleeping. I asked her a couple of weeks later how it was working out. She reported back to me that she loves its simplicity and sturdy construction. It's white noise tone is adjustable, and she is sleeping much better now.

reviews.title: no real volume
reviews.text: the sound quality is perfect white noise but beware.  It is super loud.  And twisting the side for volume control does not really do much.  it reminded me of being in an airplane the noise was so loud.

reviews.title: Great sound machine for travel
reviews.text: I bought this for my husband to use while traveling.  It was great for a hotel room to drown out noise.  It's not as loud as a regular box fan, so we won't be using it at home.  It's small enough to fit into luggage with no problem.  Isn't it amazing how many people can't sleep without noise machines now.  My daughter thought that she would be the only one in her college dorm that had to have a fan to sleep and turned out almost all of the other girls used fans as well.  Must be the noisy world that we live in now.

reviews.title: Good noise maker
reviews.text: This noise machine is not as loud as our last digital one, but the sound seems more natural. The baby seems to sleep better as well. A big plus is all the batteries we're saving. Our last noise machine would lose power in the middle of the night and emit a loud beeping sound and wake the baby. No chance of this one doing that!

reviews.title: good product
reviews.text: I ordered this sound machine for my young son after his previous (made by a different company)one broke.  At first I was disappointed that there was only one sound (fan/white noise), but my son adjusted to it very quickly.  The only complaint I have is that the volume level isn't as varied as I would have preferred.  The volume can't be turned down very low or very high for traveling away from home.

reviews.title: Love the SleepMate
reviews.text: Bought the SleepMate 580A after reading several positive reviews.  I have absolutely loved it since the first night I used it.  It drowns out the sound of snoring, cats roaming in the night, neighbor's air conditioning unit, etc.  I have slept much better since using it.  The small size makes it perfect for traveling too.  I won't leave home without it now.  So glad I purchased this unit.

reviews.title: great little sound machine
reviews.text: Small enough to fit anywhere, and the vents are completely adjustable, which helps get you just the right white noise pitch.

reviews.title: Marpac Sound Conditioner Sleep Mate 580A
reviews.text: Great product, our baby is a light sleeper and this white noise machine has improved both nap and bedtime.

reviews.title: solves my sleep problem
reviews.text: This white noise machine solves my sleep problem, but clouding my husband's snoring. It also even helps our dog calm down during thunder storms.

reviews.title: Sanity Saver - So Good I Bought Two
reviews.text:
I love the white noise it brings to a room, day or night.  To be fair, I DO also sleep with earplugs most of the time (I am a nut about sound) but even without plugs, my husband has still come and gone long after I am asleep, the dog barked or scratched in the night, and I never stirred.  First time I tried to fall asleep with Marpac and without earplugs I thought "Too loud, I'll never fall...." Zzzzz...  Street and people noise outside are drowned out.

It seems like it works in layers creating its own wall of white noise - if Marpac is the closest sound to me, it works best to disguise noise outside of that closest layer.  I put Marpac between me and the source of the noise (side of the window or wall where bulk of noise comes from) for best results.  I am sure you would still hear someone snorting right up next to you however.  Someone described it as the constant rush of air sound you would hear in an airplane, and I'd agree.  Some reviews say it's too loud - well, depends on your sensitivity and what you need!  I want it to totally mask outdoor noise (I am in a single family home, residential area, so people noise around the yards, typical residential street noise, early birds, etc.) and I do not find it too loud at all.  Can easily hold a normal conversation in a room with the machine on.  I bought the 580 as the top twists and adjusts to allow more or less sound. The lowest sound (the smallest holes opened to allow sound) is not too much for me but I can see how some people would think its loudish.  I move it around the room to suit and I can adjust to make louder, which is why I got the 580 vs. the other model.

An example of use not just for sleeping: I can hear the kids next door, one property over, playing (read: screaming and banging things really hard on the ground) to varying degrees in my own home and I was at my witts end, and I even have extra wall insulation for sound.  Can NOT tolerate noise.  Priced out sound proof windows.  $$$$!!!  Bought another Marpac to keep downstairs. Listening to the tv over the Marpac is not an issue and I don't have to have it blaring to hear over Marpac.  The air-sound just fades in to the background.

Note - it will definitely help drown out and mask the higher pitched noises.  I tried to listen for the screaming darlings next door playing basketball over Marpac and couldn't hear them.  It can not however stop things like heavy drum beats, loud stereo thumping...sound with vibrations you can feel through your body.  You need to physically stop the sound waves from traveling in those cases.

reviews.title: Works well
reviews.text: Well built mechanical device that produces a pleasant "fan" sound that does a good job of masking sounds. I have it in my bedroom and it allows me to get to sleep while other people in the house are still up and making noise.

reviews.title: Works well.
reviews.text:
Purchased for ADD son who needs something to block out distractions when trying to go to sleep. Was pleased to find this as I had one of the original units like this that I inherited from my great-grandfather (I used it because I could never get used to sleeping without a window unit air conditioner in the fall and winter months). The older unit was actually a little louder than this new one but it seems to work fairly well. It helps my son fall to sleep most nights but doesn't necessarily KEEP him asleep...but then that's not what it's supposed to do.

All in all a great device.

reviews.title: works great!
reviews.text: I've had a lot of white noise machines, and I like this one the best. It's heavy duty, and has traveled well.

reviews.title: It's fine, wish it had a bigger range of "noise"
reviews.text:
This product seems to be working fine. Several comments suggested it was "too loud" or "not loud enough," even when fully adjusted one way or the other. I agree--I wish it was louder. One thing I did that helped was to remove the foam cushion on the bottom of the device--it does not have any scratchy surfaces so that was not a concern.

We have two fans in the house--one is a floor model and one is a table-top model. Just for comparison, the "Marpac" device is maybe only half as loud as either of those two fans--it only creates the same amount of sound, in my opinion, as one of those small clip-on fans.

This device is definitely more portable than a fan, though, which is great for travel.

If anyone finds a similar device to the Marpac that's louder, or if Marpac comes out with another model, please post to the discussion.

reviews.title: Helps drown out background noise
reviews.text: Have been using it since I moved into the living room to sleep and it really helps cut down on the traffic noise out my windows. Highly recommend it.

reviews.title: Good for Sleeping Baby
reviews.text:
Our circa 1923 house has terrible squeaky wood floors, and all of our kids walk like elephants, so it is really tricky to keep a baby asleep. After reading reviews on several sleep-machine products, we decided the SleepMate 580A sounded like our best bet. We have been using it for about 3 weeks now, and we are very satisfied. It sounds a lot like a vaporizer running. I honestly expect to feel a cool mist when I walk past it. In our opinion, it is too loud to have right in our 12x12 bedroom, but the amount of noise it makes sitting right outside the door is perfect. You can still hear all of the other noises in the house (I still know when our teenage son gets home at night.), but the constant humming keeps other noises from being such a jolt to your system and waking you up. I really do think the baby is sleeping better. I would recommend this for anyone trying to sleep through noisy situations.
(Jan. 2016 - Still working, although it seems a little quieter than it used to be. We are all so hooked on it, that we still use it every night, even though the "baby" is 6.)

reviews.title: Perfect
reviews.text: What a great product.  It puts "electronic" sound contraptions to shame.  The sound is a nice rush of air and the intensity and the pitch are adjustable by turning two rings.  Love it!!

reviews.title: Great sound
reviews.text: We bought this for the nursery and are very pleased with the sound... it is very calming and loud enough to disguise the awful little yappy dogs next door but not so loud I am worried about damaging our baby's hearing. It is not any bigger in size than any of the cheaper models we were looking at. We're satisfied with this purchase. 11/3/11: I'm adding to my original review to say that we've made many, many friends and family members part of the marpac fan club by letting them borrow one of ours. We actually now have three. One for each bedroom and a travel version. VERY pleased with this purchase.

reviews.title: So happy with this product
reviews.text: I have purchased other sound machines, but the noises were annoying to me. This is just white noise, no birds chirping or waves crashing that sound fake. Great product!

reviews.title: Great for concentrating
reviews.text:
I actually got this machine because I get distracted by noises around me when I am trying to focus on an assignment (be it work or school).  Even with being in a separate room with the door closed, your still able to hear voices and sounds.  It wasn't an option for me to have an empty house every time I had to work on a project but if people were home and talking or of they had the TV on - it was just inevitable that I'd hear the TV for one second and then it was like my brain tuned into the TV and the muffled sound from rooms away took my attention from what was right in front of me.

Now, when I have work to do, I plug in this sound machine and it makes a non-annoying noise that just blocks out any background noise (like people, radio, TV, etc).  Now this is an essential for me.  I pretty much plug in my laptop and my sound machine at the same time!

I would most defiantly recommend this product!

reviews.title: We have 3!!
reviews.text: We love our sound machine (which we call our "noise maker") so much that we have one in each bedroom!  Great for traveling, as it's small, lightweight and easy to pack in your overnight bag.  Can't sleep without it.

reviews.title: Thank Heavens!!!
reviews.text: I work 3rd shift and have a bedroom that is closer to the road - which sucks but I can't do anything about that. Anyway this thing is a god-send!! I can't use noise makers unless they emit a constant sound and this does it. It just sorta sounds like fan .. actually since I've been using this I've come to find I feel comforted by this sound. Definitely try!!

reviews.title: love,love,love this!!!!!
reviews.text: This is a wonderful alternative to a fan for white noise!!!  I can not sleep without some type of noise and this device has more than met the task!  I do not like the prerecorded sound machines, so I have always used a fan to create noise.  No longer....I purchased one for each son and my sister!  Highly recommend!

reviews.title: Really good Sound Appliance
reviews.text:
I have been using various sound appliances for the last 20 years because I am a very light sleeper.  My children are also light sleepers and naptime, especially, is problematic because any little sound from another room wakes my little ones up.  I have had 2 digital sound appliances go haywire in the last 2 years.  We leave them on all the time because we are busy and we don't want to take a chance that we might forget to turn one on in the kids rooms.  They start making very loud stuttering, crazy noises which woke my children up!  So, I started looking for something different, better.

I seem to have found it with this appliance.  I like that it is mechanical, not digital.  Who needs or uses rainforest sounds?  The idea is to mask outside noises, not have your baby believe he is sleeping in the rainforest!  So far this appliance has been very reliable and helpful.  My only complaint would be that I would like it to be just a tiny bit louder.  I adjusted it to its optimal setting and we just leave it go on a table across the room from the baby's crib and it just fills the room with a soothing, soft sound.  Very womb-like!

Next time I purchase another one, I will spend $10 more for the more expensive model in hopes that it will be a little louder.  We like to use a sound machine inside the baby's room as well as outside the door.  Right now the humidifier is running outside baby's door, but when winter is over and we won't need that anymore I will buy another Marpac for that purpose.

reviews.title: Soothing
reviews.text: I bought two to help block out noise. I have noisy neighbors, but that is expected living in an apartment. I love the sound of the white sound. We have them at work too. It doesn't block out the barking dogs or the children running around down stairs, but it at least clams me down, so I'm not so frustrated. I also turn one at night to sleep.

reviews.title: Wish I knew about this years ago
reviews.text: I work nights out of town, so sleeping during the day was always a challenge. The Marpac sound screen is fantastic. I leave it on high and now can't sleep without it. I have one for home and one for work. You quickly get used to the sound and it drowns out all other noise, even loud waste disposal trucks.

reviews.title: Can't sleep without it
reviews.text: This machine is amazing. I've had a previous model for 15 years and needed another. Blocks out sounds and helps you relax to fall asleep. Great for baby's rooms!

reviews.title: Great, but not loud enough
reviews.text: The Marpac Sound Conditioner is a great product.  My only problem is that it is not loud enough by itself for white noise to sleep.  I use the Marpac on one side of my bed and another sound machine on the opposite side.

reviews.title: Works as Advertised
reviews.text: I give this sound conditioner less than five stars because I'm not convinced that "white sound" is as beneficial as I thought it would be. The product works well. There are no problems with its operation though I've had it for only a couple of weeks. If it has a design fault it might be the limited volume control. I got the SleepMate my benefit but my wife is a bit irritated with the sound. To compensate I placed it under a bench at the foot of our bed. The tone and volume control range is quite broad but a couple steps down from the low volume range would be good.

reviews.title: Not loud enough
reviews.text: I hsd to return this equipment because the sound was not enough to mask the noise I wanted it to mask, even in the high setting.

reviews.title: too loud
reviews.text: it has a great sound but is just too loud. Although adjustable, sound on lowest level is still too loud.

reviews.title: like a baby!
reviews.text: I was concerned that some reviewers found the sound to be too loud but my husband & I are quite delighted with the sound level as there are several ways to adjust. We were so happy with our purchase that we purchased another one for our son who has difficulties sleeping...he loves it as well!

reviews.title: Very loud!
reviews.text: I have always used a noise maker for sleep - ranging from electronic noisemakers to box fans.  I was excited about the Marpac because it's mechanical, which seems to have the best sound quality.  Alas, this unit was way too loud for my bedroom, even at its lowest setting.  I think it would be great for a very large room or perhaps a collection of rooms.  It also vibrates a bit, which made my wooded bedside table resonate unpleasantly.  I reckon I'll stick with my box fan.

reviews.title: I could sleep all day!!!
reviews.text: This is awesome if you light white noise! I could sleep in a tent at a construction site if I had somewhere to plug this in!

reviews.title: a great buy
reviews.text: We purchased this product because our daughter's room faces a busy street, and early morning garbage trucks, buses and motorcycles would wake her up.  She has slept wonderfully since we got the sound machine.  It is as simple as can be - plug it in and flip the switch.  We've had it for about 2 months, and couldn't be happier with it.  By the way, we can still easily hear when she wakes up through her monitor, so no worries with that.

reviews.title: Works great
reviews.text:
My wife used to use a large house fan for noise.  This is a little higher pitched (faster rpm) than the fan but still sounds pleasant enough and can be quieter or louder than the fan was depending on the setting.  Construction appears to be good quality and would expect it to last over 5 years.

Wow, it's now 2018 and still works like new! I highly recommend this product!

reviews.title: Great little machine
reviews.text: My husband works at night and sleeps during the day, and this little sound machine has enabled him to sleep like never before. Would recommend this product to anyone who needs a buffer from a noisy world.

reviews.title: Great Sound Machine!
reviews.text: I love this thing.  I purchased it for my 2 year old son who was having trouble taking decent naps & sleeping through the night and it works wonderfully.  His bedroom is very close to the living room and any noise would wake him up.  With this sound machine he takes good naps and has been good about sleeping at night.  We also have an 8 week old baby who seems to sleep a lot better with it as well, so I will be purchasing a second machine.

reviews.title: Best White Noise Machine
reviews.text:
This white noise machine is superior to any of the electronic models.  It masks noise much better and there is no annoying repeating pattern.  I am purchasing a second one for when we travel and have the kids in another room.

Even though there is only one speed setting, you can adjust the sound pitch and volume to some extent by adjusting the air vents.  In my opinion, there is really not much reason for having the second speed since you can also just put it further away to reduce the noise level.

reviews.title: Highest Praise!
reviews.text:
This wonderful machine has saved me.
My husband is a very loud snorer, who has kept me awake for years.
Now I sleep like a baby, thanks to this Sound Machine.
No kidding, I LOVE IT.
THANKS, MARPAC, for giving me my sleep back.

reviews.title: Perfect!
reviews.text: I needed a noise machine for my 10 month olds room and my 2 year olds room.  We had guests(loud) in our house for 1 month and I wanted my children to keep their nap schedule! This noise machine worked perfectly!  The guest are gone and I am still using them in their rooms!

reviews.title: Life Saver
reviews.text:
When I married over 30 years ago, my husband was use to sleeping with a fan. I could not stand it. I found this product. We both love it. I think I still have the first one I ever bought. Our children grew up with them. We travel with them.
A marriage saver : )

reviews.title: Accurate reviews for a good product
reviews.text:
I read a lot of reviews before purchasing this and I'm happy to write that the positive reviews were accurate.

I accidently ordered the 580A instead of the 980A, but decided not to return after reading that the low speed on the 980A was not very useful and few ever used it.  The 580A gives off a mixed sound of static and fan sound and does an excellent job of blocking and minimizing the noise from the TV when my partner is in her office.  I'm only about 20 feet away from her and with the door closed I can crank the TV up to over 17 on the volume meter.  Way louder than I usually turn it up (12 or 13 is normal for me).

The only things it doesn't block well are distinctive noises, like talking on the phone, although I do have a rather loud and projecting voice.

I would definitely recommend this and will probably buy another one for the bedroom when one of us goes to bed while the TV is still on.

reviews.title: Works good
reviews.text: I bought this for my home office as I talk on the phone for work a lot. I was hoping it would block out more noise than it does, but it works how it is supposed to. To block out extra noise, I may buy another. I do recommend for those of you who do not live in as noisy of an environment, and work from home. I do live in a prety noisy environment. I am not sure about using it to sleep, although I had it on for a little while to test it and felt very tired and had to go take a nap. My bedroom is quiet enough to sleep though and I prefer the noise of the TV anyway. I think this would work for people for sleep, you might have to get used to it though.

reviews.title: Love it!
reviews.text: I got this to drown out the sound of my husband snoring and I love it, if he really gets cranked up I can still hear him but it is muffled. Low normal snoring is completely drowned out. It also drowns out everything outside I never hear our dogs when they bark. It is really easy to get use to the noise, it is kind of like a fan blowing on high without the air blowing on you, it does have a small adjustment but I leave mine on high all the time. I freeze in the winter so I was worried about using a fan to drown him out because I didn't want to have the fan blowing on me all the time. I would definitely recommend it, this has made my sleep much better before I bought this I was sleeping on the couch most nights now I get to stay in the bed.

reviews.title: Great Product!
reviews.text: This product does exactly what it claims to do.  No extra bells or whistles and I find the sound level perfectly adequate for my needs. I wanted something that would last a few years and I expect this product to do just that.  Recommend buying.

reviews.title: Can't live without it!
reviews.text: I am a VERY light sleeper and I have owned this sound machine for years (actually the dual speed version).  My husband sometimes travels out of town and has realized how much he misses having it. I decided to order this single speed one and it is the same as using the dual version on the high setting. Both are wonderful, but if you want to save a little money, this one is just as effective.

reviews.title: Great product
reviews.text: This is a great product. Soooo soothing. Plus it drowns out snoring, outside traffic, and our next door neighbor's dog. Nice!

reviews.title: White Noise
reviews.text: I am very pleased with this noise machine.  It has no repeat pattern that you lie awake to anticipate the pattern.  It is simply noise.  The unit is small enought to pack in a suit case and carry it with you when you travel, which we like very much.  Much better than our other machine which has sounds of wind, train, rain, etc.

reviews.title: Perfect!
reviews.text: I tried a couple of sound machines from Target that had a white noise option and they did not compare to this one - it is the perfect soothing sound and is not too loud (wouldn't bother with the one that has two volume settings).  It is a great size for traveling!

reviews.title: Good product!
reviews.text: Bought as a gift; user/recipient delighted with item.  Exactly as advertised, shipped promptly, Purchaser and user both happy with item!

reviews.title: An absolute MUST
reviews.text:
My husband and I have used this every night for more than 8 years.  We bought it when we were living in an apartment complex with very thin walls and were disturbed at night by noise from neighboring apartments.  We'd never have survived living there without our SleepMate.

When our daughter was born nearly two years ago, we bought one for her room.  She has been sleeping through the night since three months of age and we owe a great deal of the credit to her SleepMate.

We're expecting a son in a few months and just ordered one for his room as well.  Babies thrive on white noise when they're learning to sleep, as it reminds them of the environment in the womb.

This little machine is a workhorse.  In more than 8 years, we've never needed to perform any maintenance on ours.  It has been with us through three moves and countless overnight trips.  We can't sleep without it.  It's that good.

reviews.title: Great product
reviews.text: We have one of these in our bedroom we ordered from a catalog company. Our daughter needed a way to block sound in her room so I found this one about $15 cheaper.  It only has one speed but is obviously the same brand and same manufacturer. If you are looking for a good white noise generator to create a perfect sleeping environment, I highly recommend this item.

reviews.title: Really helps my baby sleep!
reviews.text: I was getting tired of trying to keep my toddler quiet while his baby sister was sleeping. Within a week of using this sound conditioner, my baby was sleeping all night! Now, it may just be a coincidence that she started sleeping this well at the same time, but at least my little boy can crash his trucks upstairs without being told to "be quiet!" The volume of the sound is just perfect...sort of like having her humidifier on. I really like this product!

reviews.title: White noise
reviews.text: I bought two of these machines.  Both my daughters bought this also.  My daughters use it in their children's rooms to cut out the outside noises and it soothes them to sleep.  The continue to use their view monitors and sound so the won't miss anything that may be troubling going on.  My husband and i use ours to cover up the early morning barking of a dog.  It works great and is so compact.  My husband is on a sleep apnea machine and it covers up that noise.  If your husband snores, it will help cover that noise also.  My daughter tells me that the cheaper model is just as good as the more expensive one.  I'm enjoying our machines.  I put them in two parts of the room.  Great!!  If someone breaks into our house, I would just as soon not know it as I wouldn't want to have to confront an intruder.  If you are asleep, they may just leave without bothering you.

reviews.title: Pretty good white noise
reviews.text: We bought this machine for our baby's room, which faces a busy street. In does a decent job, but all-in-all I think I like sound of a fan better. I read quite a few of these reviews and found some people who think it's too loud, and others who think it's not loud enough. I think the real issue is the pitch of the sound, which is noticeably higher than the sound of the fan, so it doesn't do a great job masking low-pitch noise. Perhaps the larger model would do a better job. I would recommend finding a place where you can hear it for yourself before buying it.

reviews.title: Great for my kid's room
reviews.text: This is exactly what I was looking for. I have owned 3 different sound machines over the last 10 years and I needed one for my son that did not run on a loop. I thought this was a little loud when I first started it so I covered the 3 top holes (on the quietest setting). Then it was too quiet. The 3 holes is just enough noise to cover up the noise in our small house. It sounds like a humidifier. Wonderful product. Very happy.

reviews.title: Luving it!
reviews.text: I rent my basement out to a friend and he has different hours than I do. I kept waking up to noises from downstairs. I put this in and it has helped me a lot - masks the noises. Took a few nights to adjust to it; also used in hotels when I travel and does great at helping me sleep. Like it a loT!

reviews.title: Wonderful Little Machine
reviews.text: We bought this to use with our newborn as we have 3 other children under the age of 5 who make a ton of noise throughout the day.  It has really been a sleep saver and beats the empty humidifier we were running before!  I can move about the room while baby's sleeping without him hearing me, and it provides just enough background noise for a toddler's shrill shriek on the same floor not to totally rouse him.  Since we've had baby rooming in with us, I'm hooked on this machine and will be ordering another one when we move baby in to his own room.  We purchased this brand on recommendation from a friend who owns 3 and flies them with her when she vacations/visits relatives.  I now know why!

reviews.title: Excellent Sound Machine
reviews.text: This is wonderful.  I bought it for my toddler son's room and it has helped him to sleep much better not hearing his older sister during naps and bedtime.  Also helps with the noise from the street (we live on the same street as a school and pick-up time is quite busy and right during his nap.) The volume and intensity of the white noise sound can be adjusted by simple turns of the machine and is not too loud to block out a CD or radio playing. I would highly recommend this product.

reviews.title: Works great!
reviews.text: My 17 year old son has to share a room with his older brother who snores.  My son has unusually acute hearing so noise tends to bother him.  Finally, he is sleeping with his brother in the room without getting up and whining in the middle of the night because he can't sleep.  We're very happy.

reviews.title: Sleeping like a Baby
reviews.text: The first night we used this we slept like a baby. Still doing so. This is a great product.

reviews.title: Good for sleep or study
reviews.text: Very good product to help you sleep or study in semi-noisy environment. I live with two other roommates and it allows me to sleep all the way through the night even when they are right outside my room in the kitchen. Also, if I'm taking a test or trying to study I can turn on the machine and be able to concentrate. The only time I have an issue with the SleepMate is when I already have a headache and go to sleep; I will always wake up with the same headache that I went to sleep with. This probably won't apply to everyone though. Another feature that is nice is the noise level settings. It can be a very quite sound that you will barely notice or something that will drowned out the sound of cooking or TV in the room next to you. Overall, I recommend this product. It is very relaxing and helpful for a sound night sleep or in a situation when you need to concentrate.

reviews.title: Too Loud
reviews.text: Way too loud... instructions says you will get used to it in about a week.  I could not take the noise... no way to adjust the volume of rushing air.  I even tried it in another room..  returned for refund.

reviews.title: This is such a great product
reviews.text: I have used a sleep mate for about 9 years. Before that I used a small fan that I turned away from myself in colder weather. I love this product so much and then my son used it for a week. He said that he couldn't sleep without it so I bought another one. They are small and easy to take with you wherever you go. It has a nice fan-like noise that you can make louder or softer by moving the cover. This is just what is needed to block out sounds that disrupt sleep for those who are light sleepers or have tinitis.

reviews.title: great white noise
reviews.text: I have mine in a closet because we have a small bedroom.  The noise level is adjustable,  but still a little on the loud side.

reviews.title: Fantastic Product
reviews.text: It's well worth the money.  Our daughter has been sleeping through the night since.  I highly recommend this product for difficult sleepers.

reviews.title: works well
reviews.text: I bought this as a sound screen for a professional office.  It works quite well at creating white noise so that speaking is masked.  It has two settings.  It would be nice to have a variable control as opposed to only two choices; however, it is priced well for what I got.  I would buy it again.

reviews.title: Works as advertised to help sleep
reviews.text: Yes, this little machine has definitely improved my sleep almost from day one. I read another review that stated that you can hear a motor hum in addition to the "white noise" sound - it is true. So, I use the machine on full sound loudness, which drowns out the motor hum.  Someone who wants a quieter white noise might have to put up with the motor hum, but some might not find that sound objectionable ... All in all, I am pleased with the product.

reviews.title: Not quite "white" noise
reviews.text: My wife wanted a white noise generator to drown out the early-rising birds outside our bedroom window.  So I bought a SleepMate 580A about a month ago.  It does cover-up the bird sounds.  But as other reviewers have noted, it's quite loud - if I don't use earplugs, I wake in the morning with ringing in my ears.  But my real dissatisfaction is that within the nice whooshing white noise, you can distinctly hear the hum of the fan motor (60-cycle hum).  Maybe my unit is defective, or maybe I'm more sensitive to motor hum than most people.  I'm going to try the Marsona 1288A.

reviews.title: Worth every penny
reviews.text:
I absolutely love this item. I bought my first one 10 years ago, and spilled soda on it (sadly) and didn't waste a second replacing it.

Yes, a fan or a humidifier helps too, but really, I like that this can be used in all kinds of weather- and it travels so well!

The biggest thing I can say about it is that I love that it has a real motor- it's not a "loop" of prerecorded sounds. I can ALWAYS hear that little glitch when the loop starts over again- so annoying. The marpac product is so terrific- the real motor helps make natural white noise, and being able to turn it helps customize the sound.

You will NOT be disappointed.

reviews.title: Marpac Sound Machine
reviews.text: Can't sleep without it now!!  I forgot it on a trip and could not sleep.  Even my dogs sleep better!!

reviews.title: Response to EMF warning
reviews.text:
I was concerned when I read the review about the EMF rating and emailed the company. They promptly emailed me the following response that put my mind at ease:

Quote:
The person who posted that comment is placed a Gauss meter directly against the housing of a Sleep Mate and took a reading on his amateur Gauss meter.  He could take that same meter and walk by his refrigerator, bathroom or kitchen exhaust fans, or any device in his home that contains an electric motor and get similar readings.  If the general public had any clue how much EMF is produced by cell phones and were concern about this being a cancer risk, they would be astonished.  EMF exposure to concentrated levels from high voltage power lines or other circumstances where high levels of EMF can be measured at a great distance from the source should be considered a risk...Sleep Mate is not.

I can tell you for certain that the inventor of this product is 90 years old and he and his wife have used Sleep Mate on his nightstand nearly every night since 1962 and they are both in pretty good health (he recently broke his hip).  Neither of them have ever had any form of cancer.

This product is in its fourth generation design and has been in use in one form or another for over 45 years.

I hope this helps and please let us know if we can be of further assistance.

Kind regards,

Marpac Corporation

reviews.title: Much better than a box fan
reviews.text: My husband liked to sleep with a box fan, but I didn't like how it blew cold air and took up a lot of space. This sound machine has been a great replacement. Being able to adjust the sound tones is a real plus. The only down-side is that it is a bit bulky and not particularly attractive. For travel, we purchased [[ASIN:B0001LCJMK Sharper Image Travel Sound Soother 20 Travel Alarm Clock (SI601TNM)]], which is pricey, but does the job away from home.

reviews.title: Great product
reviews.text: Great sound conditioner.  We have had ours for a little over 2 weeks now, and it helps our newborn baby go to sleep at night.

reviews.title: Great Product
reviews.text: If you work a shift, have noisy neighbors ....and need to sleep this will help.  It masks the noise with a soothing sound ....makes shift work bearable!  My hubby has ALWAYS worked a shift...without this product there would be no way to get a goodnight's sleep!

reviews.title: Sleep Better
reviews.text: I'm a light sleeper and my wife is a hospital nurse who works a lot of nights and often has to sleep during the day. This fine device drowns out a lot of the irritating little noises (cars driving by, for example)with a pleasant white noise. This device really does help her get to sleep faster and me to stay asleep.

reviews.title: Perfect white noise
reviews.text: This is exactly what my husband and I needed.  We normally leave a fan running to provide white noise but it's getting too cold to have a fan blowing around the room.  This did the trick.  It's also perfect for traveling.

reviews.title: Restful Sleep
reviews.text: My partner now sleeps soundly despite my snoring. There may be concern for alleged RF emissions. Ours whirs seven feet from the foot of the bed.

reviews.title: Great for sleep
reviews.text: We use this for our baby daughter to sleep every night. She sleeps great, and we don't have to worry about having the TV on etc...

reviews.title: Great product!
reviews.text: We have used these sleep machine's for over 5 years and purchased these for a vacation home.  I highly recommend! They drown out outside noises and make for a good night's sleep!

reviews.title: works great
reviews.text: This is a great help with sleeping. i have it across the room because of outlet space, but it still works pretty well. My husband snores and i have noticed a real difference.  May be helpful to move it closer to your ear if you can.

reviews.title: Just as good as the 2 speed model!!!
reviews.text: I own both models of this machine, and love them equally.  No need to spend more on the one with 2 settings.  I actually own 3 of these.  Perfect for babies room to sleep at night and take naps through the day.  Perfect for me and hubby to sleep better, and for the other kids room!!!  Trust me when I say your sleep will be BETTER!!!

reviews.title: Great product if you live on a noisy street
reviews.text: We live on a major bus line, and it gets noisy at various times throughout the night and early morning hours. This machine has helped us sleep *so* much better. We sleep more soundly and wake up less during the night. It's great!

reviews.title: Didn't help
reviews.text: Not only was this product unhelpful, but there was no way to adjust the noise level.  One size fits all I guess - just didn't work for me.

reviews.title: Sleep help
reviews.text: We bought the product for our baby and the first night she used it she fell asleep within minutes.  It helps to block out the noise so we can do the things that we need to.  It is a simple design and is very easy to use.  We also took it on a trip and it fit very nicely in the suitcase because of its small size.  Great product, worth every penny.

reviews.title: Drunk neighbors heard no more
reviews.text: I have to say that apartment living in southern California can really be a drag. We are all piled on top of each other - much like the barrios that are found along major waterways in central and south America. My neighbors are really loud drunks and they have a pitbull that also is a loud drunk. I also  have neighbors on the other side who insist on playing ping pong until 2am. My two small and impressionable children have always been woken up by these neighbors shenanigans.  I purchased the Marpac Sound Screen 580 with hopes of drowning out the loud laughter and the sound of crushing beer cans. I could not have been more pleased with my purchase. My children can sleep through the night as if we lived in a normal neighborhood. They are better rested and  I am sleeping better knowing that the Sound Screen 580 is lulling my kids into a deep and satisfying slumber.

reviews.title: Does the job
reviews.text: I purchased this product because I'm a light sleeper.  The sound conditioner is a no-frills device that works adequately to block out unwanted noise, and overall I'm satisfied.  To me it sounds like a cross between a fan and a humidifier.  It's small enough to pack easily in a suitcase if you wanted to bring it with you to a hotel.

reviews.title: I bought one, loved it, bought another; Update: got one for baby, too!
reviews.text:
I bought the first one for my wife-to-be because she said she was having trouble sleeping and the fan helped.  Bingo!  This simple device is in constant use and I, too, like the effect.

My mother has had trouble sleeping for years.  She would use the TV to put her to sleep (which I could never understand).  She was up at all hours and she never got a good night's sleep.  So I bought the second one and had it shipped to her.  Bingo!  She's now sleeping better than ever.  In fact, she recently told me that she forgot to turn it on the other night and still slept well.  (I have to believe that's because she is sleeping regularly now.)

If you have trouble sleeping for whatever reason, this seems to do the trick.  $40 is a small price to pay for a consistent and good night's sleep.

Hint: since the device should be across the room, I also got an extension cord that has a switch that extends off of it (it's like a T configuration) so my wife can turn it on and off from the bedside.

Update: we just had our first baby four months ago.  I immediately got another one for the baby's room.  Seems to help her fall and stay asleep.  (She's been a good sleeper from the beginning, though, so I can't say it is some miracle cure for babies that don't sleep well.)

reviews.title: Works great, and small enough to take on trips
reviews.text:
I bought this, because I got tired of having to use a fan to get that white noise I need to sleep. If all I want is the noise why should I have the breeze to contend with too?

I like the sound it makes, because it reminds me so much of the fan I used to use. It's not so loud that it blocks everything out completely, but I wouldn't want that anyway.

The big plus is a super long cord, and a small form factor; these facts make it great to take with you on trips. Nothing is worse than trying to get to sleep in a hotel room without some sort of noise. No more having to set the radio to static or turn on the bathroom fan (which most places don't even have anymore).

I'm so pleased that I'm going to buy another one for our daughter's room.

reviews.title: Great for children
reviews.text: We originally got this to replace the "fan noise" in the winter due to our sons' room being so cold.  The first couple days the sound seemed so loud but you quickly get used to it.  We've discovered it's very helpful for blocking out the noise of other children running through the house while our newborn is sleeping in addition to the city noises at night.  With the adjustability dials it's ideal for a nursery or bedroom for those who cannot sleep without a fan.  It doesn't however, cover the sound of someone coughing or snoring loudly.  Would highly recommend this to anyone looking for a sound machine for environmental noise, especially for children.

reviews.title: Effective white noise but has metallic clicking/rattling
reviews.text: This product does create white noise but it has a metallic clicking and rattling, rendering the product useless.

reviews.title: Slept like a baby
reviews.text: I have to admit when I got it and realized that the basic idea of this machine was that it was a fan... I was a bit put out. But honestly, I used it last night and I got the best sleep I have had in years. We usually keep the fan on our ac going or run an actual fan which dries your sinuses out and makes you cold. This little machine doesn't do that and the sound blocks out a lot of outside noise.  I don't think I will be going anywhere without it anytime soon.  I am thrilled and so glad I spent the money on it. The good sleep is WELL worth it.

reviews.title: Excellent service
reviews.text: I had a wonder experience in purchasing the SleepMate 580 from Amazon. i had my SleepMate within 3 days of placing my order. The SleepMate has my husband and I sleeping like babies.  We were used to an air conditioner hum all summer and this product works great to replace the sound.

reviews.title: Great little machine
reviews.text: I use it to keep my office private and confidential.  Couldn't be happier with the product.
